paragraphs: Medvladje in nasledstvena vojna sta se v Kraljevini Portugalski začela leta 1383, ko je kralj Ferdinand I. umrl brez sinov, in končala, ko je bil leta 1385 po zmagi v bitki pri Aljubarroti kronan kralj Ivan I.
Portugalci to obdobje razumejo kot svoje prvo narodno gibanje upora proti kastiljskemu vmešavanju, Robert Durand pa ga ima za »veliko razkritje narodne zavesti«.

Meščanstvo in plemstvo sta skupaj trdno postavila dinastijo Avis, vejo portugalske burgundske hiše, na neodvisen prestol. To je bilo v nasprotju z dolgimi državljanskimi vojnami v Franciji (stoletna vojna) in Angliji (vojna rož), v katerih so se aristokratske frakcije silovito bojevale proti centralizirani monarhiji.

source.title: 1383–1385 Portuguese interregnum
paragraphs: An interregnum and a war of succession began in the Kingdom of Portugal in 1383 when King Ferdinand I died leaving no sons and ended when King John I was crowned in 1385 after his victory during the Battle of Aljubarrota.
The Portuguese interpret the era as their earliest national resistance movement to counter Castilian intervention, and Robert Durand considers it as the "great revealer of national consciousness".

The bourgeoisie and the nobility worked together to establish the Avis dynasty, a branch of the Portuguese House of Burgundy, securely on an independent throne. That contrasted with the lengthy civil wars in France (Hundred Years' War) and England (War of the Roses), which had aristocratic factions fighting powerfully against a centralised monarchy.

1981 Spanish coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Španiji leta 1981
paragraphs: Februarja 1981 so desničarski, frankistični pripadniki civilne garde in španske vojske v Španiji poskusili z državnim udarom. Neuspeh udara je pomenil zadnji resen poskus, da bi Španijo vrnili v frankistično državo, in je utrdil španski proces demokratizacije. Kralj Juan Carlos I. je imel pri preprečitvi udara pomembno vlogo, monarhija pa je zato pridobila novo legitimnost.

source.title: 1981 Spanish coup attempt
paragraphs: A coup d'état was attempted in Spain in February 1981 by right-wing, Francoist elements of the Civil Guard and the Spanish military. The failure of the coup marked the last serious attempt to revert Spain to a Francoist state and served to consolidate Spain's democratization process. King Juan Carlos I played a major role in foiling the coup, and the monarchy emerged with renewed legitimacy as a result.

28 May 1926 coup d'état.headline: Državni udar 28. maja 1926
paragraphs: Državni udar 28. maja 1926, včasih imenovan revolucija 28. maja ali v času korporativističnega režima Estado Novo (»nova država«) narodna revolucija (portugalsko: Revolução Nacional), je bil vojaški udar nacionalističnega izvora, ki je končal nestabilno prvo portugalsko republiko in začel 48 let korporativistične in nacionalistične vladavine na Portugalskem. Režim, ki je neposredno nastal z udarom, Ditadura Nacional (narodna diktatura), se je pozneje preoblikoval v Estado Novo, ta pa je trajal do revolucije nageljnov leta 1974.

source.title: 28 May 1926 coup d'état
paragraphs: The 28 May 1926 coup d'état, sometimes called 28 May Revolution or, during the period of the corporatist Estado Novo (English: New State), the National Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução Nacional), was a military coup of a nationalist origin, that put an end to the unstable Portuguese First Republic and initiated 48 years of corporatist and nationalist rule within Portugal. The regime that immediately resulted from the coup, the Ditadura Nacional (National Dictatorship), would be later refashioned into the Estado Novo, which in turn lasted until the Carnation Revolution in 1974.

Alvor Agreement.headline: Sporazum iz Alvorja
paragraphs: Sporazum iz Alvorja, podpisan 15. januarja 1975 v Alvorju na Portugalskem, je Angoli podelil neodvisnost od Portugalske, ki je začela veljati 11. novembra, in formalno končal 13 let trajajočo angolsko vojno za neodvisnost.

Sporazum so podpisali portugalska vlada, Ljudsko gibanje za osvoboditev Angole (MPLA), Narodna fronta za osvoboditev Angole (FNLA) in Narodna zveza za popolno neodvisnost Angole (UNITA), z njim pa je bila ustanovljena prehodna vlada iz predstavnikov teh štirih strani. Fronta za osvoboditev enklave Cabinda (FLEC) in Vzhodni upor ga nista podpisala, ker so ju druge strani izključile iz pogajanj. Prehodna vlada je kmalu razpadla, saj je vsaka od nacionalističnih frakcij, nezaupljiva do drugih in nepripravljena deliti oblast, skušala s silo prevzeti nadzor nad državo. Tako se je začela angolska državljanska vojna. Sporazum je dobil ime po vasi Alvor v južni portugalski pokrajini Algarve, kjer so ga podpisali.

source.title: Alvor Agreement
paragraphs: The Alvor Agreement, signed on 15 January 1975 in Alvor, Portugal, granted Angola independence from Portugal on 11 November and formally ended the 13-year-long Angolan War of Independence.

The agreement was signed by the Portuguese government, the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA), the National Liberation Front of Angola (FNLA), National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA), and it established a transitional government composed of representatives of those four parties. It was not signed by the Front for the Liberation of the Enclave of Cabinda (FLEC) or the Eastern Revolt as the other parties excluded them from negotiations. The transitional government soon fell apart, with each of the nationalist factions, distrustful of the others and unwilling to share power, attempting to take control of the country by force. This initiated the Angolan Civil War. The name of the agreement comes from the village of Alvor, in the southern Portuguese region of Algarve, where it was signed.

Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824.headline: Angleško-nizozemska pogodba iz leta 1824
paragraphs: Angleško-nizozemska pogodba iz leta 1824, znana tudi kot londonska pogodba (nizozemsko: Verdrag van Londen), je bila pogodba med Združenim kraljestvom in Nizozemsko, sklenjena 17. marca 1824 v Londonu. Razrešila naj bi spore, ki so nastali pri izvajanju angleško-nizozemske pogodbe iz leta 1814. Za Nizozemsko sta jo podpisala Hendrik Fagel in Anton Reinhard Falck, za Britanijo pa George Canning in Charles Williams-Wynn.

source.title: Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824
paragraphs: The Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824, also known as the Treaty of London (Dutch: Verdrag van Londen), was a treaty between the United Kingdom and the Netherlands in London on 17 March 1824. The treaty was to resolve disputes arising from the execution of the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814. For the Dutch, it was signed by Hendrik Fagel and Anton Reinhard Falck, and for the British, George Canning and Charles Williams-Wynn.

Anglo-Egyptian treaty of 1936.headline: Angleško-egiptovska pogodba iz leta 1936
paragraphs: Angleško-egiptovska pogodba iz leta 1936 (uradno Pogodba o zavezništvu med njegovim veličanstvom v imenu Združenega kraljestva in njegovim veličanstvom egiptovskim kraljem) je bila pogodba med Združenim kraljestvom in Kraljevino Egipt. Precej je zmanjšala britanski vpliv na egiptovsko notranjo politiko, a je Britanija ohranila velik vpliv na egiptovsko zunanjo politiko in obrambo, zlasti na Sueški prekop.

Po pogodbi je moralo Združeno kraljestvo iz Egipta umakniti vse svoje enote razen tistih, ki so bile potrebne za zaščito Sueškega prekopa in njegove okolice, to je 10.000 vojakov s pomožnim osebjem. Združeno kraljestvo je poleg tega moralo oskrbovati in uriti egiptovsko vojsko ter Egiptu v primeru vojne pomagati pri obrambi. Pogodba naj bi veljala 20 let; pogajanja so potekala v palači Zaafarana, podpisana je bila 26. avgusta 1936 v Londonu, ratificirana pa 22. decembra. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov je bila registrirana 6. januarja 1937.

source.title: Anglo-Egyptian treaty of 1936
paragraphs: The Anglo-Egyptian Treaty of 1936 (officially, The Treaty of Alliance Between His Majesty, in Respect of the United Kingdom, and His Majesty, the King of Egypt) was a treaty signed between the United Kingdom and the Kingdom of Egypt. The treaty significantly reduced Britain's influence in Egypt's domestic policy but Britain still had significant influence in Egypt's foreign policy and defence, especially the Suez Canal.

Under the terms of the treaty, the United Kingdom was required to withdraw all its troops from Egypt, except those necessary to protect the Suez Canal and its surroundings, numbering 10,000 troops plus auxiliary personnel. Additionally, the United Kingdom would supply and train Egypt's army and assist in its defence in case of war. The treaty was to last for 20 years; it was negotiated in the Zaafarana palace, signed in London on 26 August 1936 and ratified on 22 December. It was registered in the League of Nations Treaty Series on 6 January 1937.

Anglo-German Naval Agreement.headline: Angleško-nemški pomorski sporazum
paragraphs: Angleško-nemški pomorski sporazum (AGNA) z dne 18. junija 1935 je bil pomorski sporazum med Združenim kraljestvom in Nemčijo, ki je določal velikost Kriegsmarine v razmerju do Kraljeve vojne mornarice.

Sporazum je trajno določil razmerje, po katerem naj bi skupna tonaža Kriegsmarine znašala 35 % skupne tonaže Kraljeve vojne mornarice. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov je bil registriran 12. julija 1935. Adolf Hitler ga je razveljavil 28. aprila 1939.

source.title: Anglo-German Naval Agreement
paragraphs: The Anglo-German Naval Agreement (AGNA) of 18 June 1935 was a naval agreement between the United Kingdom and Germany that regulated the size of the Kriegsmarine in relation to the Royal Navy.

The Anglo-German Naval Agreement fixed a ratio whereby the total tonnage of the Kriegsmarine was to be 35% of the total tonnage of the Royal Navy on a permanent basis. It was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 12 July 1935. The agreement was abrogated by Adolf Hitler on 28 April 1939.

Anglo-irski sporazum je bil pogodba med Združenim kraljestvom in Republiko Irsko iz leta 1985, ki naj bi pomagala končati nemire (The Troubles) na Severnem Irskem. Pogodba je irski vladi dala svetovalno vlogo pri upravljanju Severne Irske, hkrati pa je potrdila, da se ustavni položaj Severne Irske ne bo spremenil, razen če bi se večina njenih prebivalcev strinjala s pridružitvijo republiki. Določila je tudi pogoje za ustanovitev decentralizirane vlade soglasja v regiji.
Sporazum sta 15. novembra 1985 na gradu Hillsborough podpisala britanska predsednica vlade Margaret Thatcher in irski taoiseach (predsednik vlade) Garret FitzGerald.

source.title: Anglo-Irish Agreement
paragraphs: The Anglo-Irish Agreement was a 1985 treaty between the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland which aimed to help bring an end to the Troubles in Northern Ireland. The treaty gave the Irish government an advisory role in Northern Ireland's government while confirming that there would be no change in the constitutional position of Northern Ireland unless a majority of its citizens agreed to join the Republic. It also set out conditions for the establishment of a devolved consensus government in the region.
The Agreement was signed on 15 November 1985, at Hillsborough Castle, by British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher and Irish Taoiseach (prime minister) Garret FitzGerald.

Anglo-irska pogodba iz leta 1921 (irsko: An Conradh Angla-Éireannach), na Irskem splošno znana kot Pogodba, uradno pa Členi sporazuma o pogodbi med Veliko Britanijo in Irsko, je bila sporazum med vlado Združenega kraljestva Velike Britanije in Irske ter vlado Irske republike, s katerim se je končala irska osamosvojitvena vojna. Predvidela je, da bo v enem letu ustanovljena Irska svobodna država kot samoupraven dominion v »skupnosti narodov, znani kot Britanski imperij«, s statusom, »enakim statusu dominiona Kanada«. Severni Irski, ki je nastala z zakonom o vladi Irske iz leta 1920, je dala tudi možnost izstopa iz Irske svobodne države (12. člen), ki jo je parlament Severne Irske izkoristil.

source.title: Anglo-Irish Treaty
paragraphs: The 1921 Anglo-Irish Treaty (Irish: An Conradh Angla-Éireannach), commonly known in Ireland as The Treaty and officially the Articles of Agreement for a Treaty Between Great Britain and Ireland, was an agreement between the government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland and the government of the Irish Republic that concluded the Irish War of Independence. It provided for the establishment of the Irish Free State within a year as a self-governing dominion within the "community of nations known as the British Empire", a status "the same as that of the Dominion of Canada". It also provided Northern Ireland, which had been created by the Government of Ireland Act 1920, an option to opt out of the Irish Free State (Article 12), which was exercised by the Parliament of Northern Ireland.

Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland.headline: Anglonormanska invazija na Irsko
paragraphs: Anglonormanska invazija na Irsko je potekala konec 12. stoletja, ko so Anglonormani postopoma osvojili in pridobili obsežna ozemlja na Irskem, nad katerimi so nato suverenost zahtevali angleški kralji. Anglonormani so trdili, da je invazijo odobrila papeška bula Laudabiliter. V času invazije je bila gelska Irska razdeljena na več kraljestev, pri čemer je veliki kralj zahteval nadoblast nad večino drugih kraljev. Anglonormanska invazija je bila prelomnica v irski zgodovini, saj se je z njo začelo več kot 800 let britanske navzočnosti na Irskem.

Maja 1169 so se na Irskem izkrcali anglonormanski najemniki na prošnjo Diarmaita mac Murchade (Dermota MacMurragha), odstavljenega kralja Leinstra, ki je z njihovo pomočjo želel znova dobiti kraljevsko oblast. To jim je uspelo v nekaj tednih, nato pa so plenili po sosednjih kraljestvih. Vojaško posredovanje je odobril angleški kralj Henrik II. Diarmait je Henriku v zameno prisegel zvestobo in Normanom obljubil zemljo.

source.title: Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland
paragraphs: The Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland took place during the late 12th century, when Anglo-Normans gradually conquered and acquired large swathes of land in Ireland over which the kings of England then claimed sovereignty. The Anglo-Normans claimed the invasion was sanctioned by the papal bull Laudabiliter. At the time of the invasion, Gaelic Ireland consisted of several kingdoms, with a High King claiming lordship over most of the other kings. The Anglo-Norman invasion was a watershed in Ireland's history, marking the beginning of over 800 years of British presence in Ireland.

In May 1169, Anglo-Norman mercenaries landed in Ireland at the request of Diarmait mac Murchada (Dermot MacMurragh), the deposed King of Leinster, who sought their help in regaining his kingship. They achieved this within weeks and raided neighbouring kingdoms. This military intervention was sanctioned by King Henry II of England. In return, Diarmait had sworn loyalty to Henry and promised land to the Normans.

Anglo-Polish alliance.headline: Angleško-poljsko zavezništvo
paragraphs: Vojaško zavezništvo med Združenim kraljestvom in Poljsko sta državi formalizirali z angleško-poljskim sporazumom 31. marca 1939, s poznejšima dodatkoma iz let 1940 in 1944, za medsebojno pomoč v primeru vojaškega napada nacistične Nemčije, kot je določal tajni protokol.

source.title: Anglo-Polish alliance
paragraphs: The military alliance between the United Kingdom and Poland was formalised by the Anglo-Polish Agreement on 31 March 1939, with subsequent addenda of 1940 and 1944, for mutual assistance in case of a military invasion from Nazi Germany, as specified in a secret protocol.

Anglo-Russian Convention.headline: Angleško-ruska konvencija
paragraphs: Angleško-ruska konvencija iz leta 1907 je bila pogodba, ki sta jo Združeno kraljestvo in Ruski imperij podpisala 31. avgusta 1907 v Sankt Peterburgu. Z njo se je končala »velika igra« v Srednji Aziji, kjer sta dolgo tekmovala evropska kolonialna imperija. Pogodba je tudi okrepila angleško-ruski interes, da bi obšli Nemško cesarstvo, ki je grozilo z gradnjo železnice od Berlina do Bagdada in s povezovanjem z oslabljenim Osmanskim cesarstvom.

Konvencija je končala dolg spor obeh strani glede Perzije. Združeno kraljestvo je obljubilo, da se ne bo vmešavalo v severno Perzijo, Rusija pa je priznala južno Perzijo za del britanskega vplivnega območja. Rusija je obljubila tudi, da se ne bo vmešavala v Tibet in Afganistan. London ji je v zameno dal posojila in nekaj politične podpore. Konvencija je majave britansko-ruske odnose postavila v ospredje, saj je utrdila meje, ki so določale nadzor obeh strani v Perziji, Afganistanu in Tibetu. Sporazum je sčasoma postal sestavni del trojne antante.

source.title: Anglo-Russian Convention
paragraphs: The Anglo-Russian Convention of 1907 was a treaty signed between United Kingdom and the Russian Empire on 31 August 1907 in Saint Petersburg. It marked the end of the "Great Game" in Central Asia, where a longstanding rivalry had ensued between the two European colonial empires. The treaty also furthered the Anglo-Russian interest to outflank the German Empire, which was threatening to establish a railroad from Berlin to Baghdad and align with the weakened Ottoman Empire.

The Convention ended the long dispute over Persia between the two parties. The United Kingdom promised to stay out of northern Persia, and Russia recognized southern Persia as part of the British sphere of influence. Russia also promised to stay out of Tibet and Afghanistan. In exchange, London extended loans and some political support. The convention brought shaky British–Russian relations to the forefront by solidifying boundaries that identified respective control in Persia, Afghanistan, and Tibet. This agreement would eventually form a component of the Triple Entente.

Angleško-španska vojna v letih 1654–1660 je potekala med Angleško republiko in Habsburško Španijo. Gnalo jo je gospodarsko in versko tekmovanje med državama, pri čemer je vsaka stran na različne načine, denimo s kaperstvom in pomorskimi odpravami, napadala trgovske in kolonialne interese druge.

Leta 1655 je angleška amfibijska odprava vdrla na špansko ozemlje na Karibih in nazadnje zavzela otok Jamajko. Leta 1657 je Anglija sklenila zavezništvo s Francijo, s čimer se je angleško-španska vojna združila s širšo francosko-špansko vojno; glavni kopenski spopadi so potekali v Španski Nizozemski.

Vojna se je sicer končala po restavraciji angleškega kralja Karla II. leta 1660, toda napetosti na Karibih zaradi angleške posesti Jamajke so spopad s presledki ohranjale še več kot deset let. Med drugim je znani kaper Henry Morgan napadal špansko ozemlje. Vojna se je uradno končala z mirovnima pogodbama, podpisanima v Madridu v letih 1667 in 1670.

source.title: Anglo-Spanish War (1654–1660)
paragraphs: The Anglo-Spanish War of 1654–1660 was fought between the Commonwealth of England and Habsburg Spain. It was driven by the economic and religious rivalry between the two countries, with each side attacking the other's commercial and colonial interests in various ways, such as privateering and naval expeditions.

In 1655, an English amphibious expedition invaded Spanish territory in the Caribbean, eventually capturing the island of Jamaica. In 1657, England formed an alliance with France, merging the Anglo-Spanish war with the larger Franco-Spanish War, with major land actions that took place in the Spanish Netherlands.

Although the war was terminated after the Restoration of King Charles II of England in 1660, tensions in the Caribbean with regard to the English possession of Jamaica kept the conflict going intermittently for over ten years. This included raids on Spanish territory by notable Privateer Henry Morgan. The war officially ended with two peace treaties, which were signed at Madrid in 1667 and 1670.

Aragon Offensive.headline: Aragonska ofenziva
paragraphs: Aragonska ofenziva je bila pomemben vojaški pohod v španski državljanski vojni, ki se je začel po bitki pri Teruelu. Ofenziva, ki je trajala od 7. marca do 19. aprila 1938, je strla republikanske sile, preplavila Aragonijo ter osvojila dele Katalonije in Levanta.

source.title: Aragon Offensive
paragraphs: The Aragon Offensive was an important military campaign during the Spanish Civil War, which began after the Battle of Teruel. The offensive, which ran from March 7, 1938, to April 19, 1938, smashed the Republican forces, overran Aragon, and conquered parts of Catalonia and the Levante.

Barcelona Convention.headline: Barcelonska konvencija
paragraphs: Konvencija o varstvu morskega okolja in obalnega območja Sredozemlja, prvotno Konvencija o varstvu Sredozemskega morja pred onesnaževanjem, pogosto imenovana kar Barcelonska konvencija, je regionalna konvencija, sprejeta leta 1976, katere namen je preprečevati in zmanjševati onesnaževanje Sredozemskega morja z ladij, iz zrakoplovov in s kopnega. To med drugim vključuje odmetavanje, odtekanje in izpuste. Podpisnice so se zavezale k sodelovanju in medsebojni pomoči pri ukrepanju ob onesnaženjih, spremljanju in znanstvenem raziskovanju. Konvencija je bila sprejeta 16. februarja 1976 in spremenjena 10. junija 1995.

Barcelonska konvencija in njeni protokoli tvorijo pravni okvir Sredozemskega akcijskega načrta (sprejetega leta 1975), ki je nastal v okviru Programa za regionalna morja Programa Združenih narodov za okolje (UNEP).

source.title: Barcelona Convention
paragraphs: The Convention for the Protection of the Marine Environment and the Coastal Region of the Mediterranean, originally the Convention for Protection of the Mediterranean Sea against Pollution, and often simply referred to as the Barcelona Convention, is a regional convention adopted in 1976 to prevent and abate pollution from ships, aircraft and land based sources in the Mediterranean Sea. This includes but is not limited to dumping, run-off and discharges. Signers agreed to cooperate and assist in dealing with pollution emergencies, monitoring and scientific research. The convention was adopted on 16 February 1976 and amended on 10 June 1995.

The Barcelona Convention and its protocols form the legal framework of the Mediterranean Action Plan (approved in 1975), developed under the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) Regional Seas Programme.

Battle of Alarcos.headline: Bitka pri Alarcosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Alarcosu (18. julija 1195) je potekala med Almohadi pod vodstvom Abu Jusufa Jakuba al Mansurja in kastiljskim kraljem Alfonzom VIII. Končala se je s porazom kastiljskih sil in njihovim umikom v Toledo, Almohadi pa so znova osvojili Trujillo, Montánchez in Talavero.

source.title: Battle of Alarcos
paragraphs: Battle of Alarcos (July 18, 1195) was fought between the Almohads led by Abu Yusuf Ya'qub al-Mansur and King Alfonso VIII of Castile. It resulted in the defeat of the Castilian forces and their subsequent retreat to Toledo, whereas the Almohads reconquered Trujillo, Montánchez, and Talavera.

Battle of Albuera.headline: Bitka pri Albueri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Albueri (16. maja 1811) je bila bitka polotoške vojne. Mešani britanski, španski in portugalski korpus se je spopadel z deli francoske Armée du Midi (Južne armade) pri majhni španski vasi Albuera, približno 20 kilometrov južno od obmejnega utrjenega mesta Badajoz v Španiji.
notes: The miles conversion (12 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Albuera
paragraphs: The Battle of Albuera (16 May 1811) was a battle during the Peninsular War. A mixed British, Spanish and Portuguese corps engaged elements of the French armée du Midi (Army of the South) at the small Spanish village of Albuera, about 20 kilometres (12 mi) south of the frontier fortress-town of Badajoz, Spain.

Bitka pri Aljubarroti je potekala 14. avgusta 1385 med Kraljevino Portugalsko in Kastiljsko krono. Sile portugalskega kralja Ivana I. in njegovega konetabla Nuna Álvaresa Pereire so se z angleškimi zavezniki pri São Jorgeju, med mestoma Leiria in Alcobaça v osrednji Portugalski, spopadle z vojsko kastiljskega kralja Ivana I., njenimi aragonskimi in francoskimi zavezniki ter genovskimi najemniki. Portugalci so odločilno zmagali, s čimer so končali kastiljske težnje po portugalskem prestolu in krizo v letih 1383–1385 ter utrdili Ivanov položaj portugalskega kralja.

Portugalska neodvisnost je bila zavarovana in nastala je nova dinastija Avis. Posamezni obmejni spopadi s kastiljskimi enotami so se nadaljevali do smrti kastiljskega kralja Ivana I. leta 1390, a za novo dinastijo niso pomenili prave nevarnosti.

source.title: Battle of Aljubarrota
paragraphs: The Battle of Aljubarrota was fought between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Crown of Castile on 14 August 1385. Forces commanded by King John I of Portugal and his Constable Nuno Álvares Pereira, with the support of English allies, opposed the army of King John I of Castile with its Aragonese and French allies, as well as Genoese mercenaries at São Jorge, between the towns of Leiria and Alcobaça, in central Portugal. The result was a decisive victory for the Portuguese, ruling out Castilian ambitions to the Portuguese throne, ending the 1383–85 Crisis and assuring John's position as King of Portugal.

Portuguese independence was safeguarded and a new dynasty, the House of Aviz, was established. Scattered border confrontations with Castilian troops would persist until the death of John I of Castile in 1390, but these posed no real threat to the new dynasty.

Bitka pri Almansi je potekala 25. aprila 1707 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo. V njej sta se spopadli vojska, zvesta španskemu kralju Filipu V., burbonskemu pretendentu za španski prestol, in vojska, ki je podpirala njegovega habsburškega tekmeca, nadvojvodo Karla Avstrijskega. Burbonci so odločilno zmagali in Filipu znova pridobili večino vzhodne Španije.

Burbonsko vojsko je vodil vojvoda Berwick, nezakonski sin angleškega kralja Jakoba II., habsburške sile pa Henri de Massue, grof Galway, izgnani francoski hugenot. Zato je to »verjetno edina bitka v zgodovini, v kateri je angleškim silam poveljeval Francoz, francoskim pa Anglež«.

source.title: Battle of Almansa
paragraphs: The Battle of Almansa took place on 25 April 1707, during the War of the Spanish Succession. It was fought between an army loyal to Philip V of Spain, Bourbon claimant to the Spanish throne, and one supporting his Habsburg rival, Archduke Charles of Austria. The result was a decisive Bourbon victory that reclaimed most of eastern Spain for Philip.

The Bourbon army was commanded by the Duke of Berwick, illegitimate son of James II of England, while Habsburg forces were led by Henri de Massue, Earl of Galway, an exiled French Huguenot. This makes it "probably the only battle in history in which the English forces were commanded by a Frenchman, the French by an Englishman."

Battle of Almenar.headline: Bitka pri Almenaru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Almenaru je potekala 27. julija 1710 blizu Balaguerja v Kataloniji, v vojni za špansko nasledstvo.

Junija 1710 je burbonsko-španska vojska Filipa V. vstopila v Katalonijo, da bi zavzela Balaguer; zavezniške britanske, portugalske, nizozemske in avstrijske enote, ki so podpirale nadvojvodo Karla, so tem premikom nasprotovale in vojski sta se popoldne 27. julija spopadli tik severno od Lleide. Filipova vojska je bila poražena in se je morala umakniti za reko Ebro, a je ostala cela.

source.title: Battle of Almenar
paragraphs: The Battle of Almenar took place near Balaguer in Catalonia, on 27 July 1710, during the War of the Spanish Succession.

In June 1710, the Bourbon-Spanish army of Phillip V crossed into Catalonia in an attempt to capture Balaguer; an Allied force of British, Portuguese, Dutch and Austrian troops supporting Archduke Charles countered these moves and the two armies met in battle just to the north of Lleida on the afternoon of 27 July. Philip's army was defeated and forced to withdraw behind the Ebro but remained intact.

Battle of Ashdown.headline: Bitka pri Ashdownu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ashdownu je bila zmaga Zahodnih Sasov nad dansko vikinško vojsko okoli 8. januarja 871. Kraj Ashdown ni znan, morda pa je to Kingstanding Hill v Berkshiru. Drugi pisci postavljajo bitko blizu Starvealla, malo severno od vasi Aldworth in jugovzhodno od Lowbury Hilla.

Zahodne Sase sta vodila kralj Æthelred in njegov mlajši brat, poznejši kralj Alfred Veliki, vikinška poveljnika pa sta bila Bagsecg in Halfdan. Bitko opisujeta Anglosaška kronika in Asserjevo delo Življenje kralja Alfreda.

source.title: Battle of Ashdown
paragraphs: The Battle of Ashdown was a West Saxon victory over a Danish Viking army on about 8 January 871. The location of Ashdown is not known, but may be Kingstanding Hill in Berkshire. Other writers place the battle near Starveall, a short distance north of the village of Aldworth and south east of Lowbury Hill.

The West Saxons were led by King Æthelred and his younger brother, the future King Alfred the Great, while the Viking commanders were Bagsecg and Halfdan. The battle is described in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle and Asser's Life of King Alfred.

Battle of Assandun.headline: Bitka pri Assandunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Assandunu (ali Ashingdonu) je potekala 18. oktobra 1016 med dansko in angleško vojsko. Ni soglasja, ali je Assandun Ashdon blizu Saffron Waldna v severnem Essexu v Angliji ali, kot so dolgo domnevali, Ashingdon blizu Rochforda v jugovzhodnem Essexu. Končala se je z zmago Dancev pod kraljem Knutom, ki je premagal angleško vojsko kralja Edmunda Železnega. Bitki je sledila pogodba, ki je Anglijo razdelila med Knuta in Edmunda, a je Edmund kmalu umrl in Knut je, kot je bilo dogovorjeno, postal nesporni kralj.

source.title: Battle of Assandun
paragraphs: The Battle of Assandun (or Ashingdon) was fought between Danish and English armies on 18 October 1016. There is disagreement whether Assandun may be Ashdon near Saffron Walden in north Essex, England, or, as long supposed, Ashingdon near Rochford in south-east Essex. It ended in victory for the Danes, led by King Cnut, who triumphed over an English army led by King Edmund Ironside. The battle was followed by a treaty dividing England between Cnut and Edmund, but Edmund died shortly afterwards and Cnut then became undisputed king as had been agreed.

Battle of Atoleiros.headline: Bitka pri Atoleirosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Atoleirosu je potekala 6. aprila 1384 med portugalskimi silami in kazensko odpravo, ki jo je iz Kastilije poslal Ivan I. Bitka se je odvila blizu kraja Fronteira v Alenteju in je bila prva večja bitka krize v letih 1383–1385.

Nuno Álvares Pereira je bil izbran za obrambo meje na tem območju, saj so se bali, da bi kastiljska vojska lahko tu vdrla na Portugalsko. Iz Lizbone je odšel s 1000 pešci in na poti v Atoleiros okrepil svoje sile. Kastiljsko vojsko je sestavljalo okoli 5000 mož, večinoma konjenikov, ki so oblegali vas Fronteira. Ko se je Pereira približal, so mu Kastiljci poslali odposlanca, ki naj bi ga prepričal, da se umakne. Pereira je zavrnil, Kastiljci pa so prekinili obleganje in mu šli naproti. Portugalci so se postavili v obrambni kvadrat. V kratki bitki, ki je sledila, kastiljska konjenica portugalske formacije ni mogla prebiti in je utrpela hude izgube. Portugalci izgub niso imeli, Kastiljci pa so se umaknili.
notes: The Portuguese pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Atoleiros
paragraphs: The Battle of Atoleiros (Portuguese pronunciation: [ɐtuˈlɐjɾuʃ]) took place on 6 April 1384, between a Portuguese force and a punitive expedition from Castile sent by John I. The battle took place near the population centre of Fronteira in Alentejo. It was the first major battle of the 1383–1385 Crisis.

Nuno Álvares Pereira had been chosen to protect the frontier in this area, amid fear that a Castilian force could enter Portugal here. He left Lisbon with 1,000 infantry, adding to the strength of his forces on his way to Atoleiros. The Castilian army consisted of some 5,000 men, mostly cavalry, which was besieging the village of Fronteira. As Pereira approached, the Castilians sent an emissary to him, attempting to persuade him to retire. He refused, and the Castilians advanced to meet him, lifting the siege. The Portuguese formed a defensive square. In the short battle that followed, the Castilian cavalry was unable to break the Portuguese formation, suffering heavy losses. The Portuguese suffered none, and the Castilians withdrew.

Battle of Badajoz (1936).headline: Bitka za Badajoz (1936)
paragraphs: Bitka za Badajoz je bila eden prvih večjih spopadov španske državljanske vojne in se je končala s taktično in strateško zmago nacionalistov, ki pa jih je stala precej časa in vojakov. Po več dneh obstreljevanja in bombardiranja so nacionalisti 14. avgusta 1936 naskočili utrjeno obmejno mesto Badajoz, s čimer so Špansko republiko odrezali od sosednje Portugalske in povezali severno in južno območje pod nacionalističnim nadzorom (čeprav so dejanski stik s severnimi enotami generala Emilia Mole vzpostavili šele 8. septembra).

source.title: Battle of Badajoz (1936)
paragraphs: The Battle of Badajoz was one of the first major engagements of the Spanish Civil War, resulting in a tactical and strategic Nationalist victory, however at a significant cost in time and troops. After several days of shelling and bombardment, Nationalists stormed the fortified border city of Badajoz on August 14, 1936, cutting off the Spanish Republic from neighbouring Portugal and linking the northern and southern zones of Nationalist control (although actual contact with General Emilio Mola's northern troops was not established until September 8).

Battle of Badon.headline: Bitka pri Badonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Badonu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Mons Badonicus, naj bi v porimski Britaniji v začetku 6. stoletja potekala med Briti in Anglosasi. Pripisujejo ji veliko zmago Britov, ki je za nekaj časa ustavila širjenje anglosaških kraljestev proti zahodu.

Najzgodnejšo znano omembo bitke je okoli let 543–547 zapisal britanski klerik Gildas. Danes je bitka znana predvsem po udeležbi moža, ki so se ga pozneje spominjali kot legendarnega kralja Arturja. Njegovo ime ni znano, ime v obliki »Artur« pa se prvič pojavi v Historii Brittonum iz 9. stoletja, kjer je omenjen kot vojskovodja, ki se je bitke udeležil skupaj z britonskimi kralji, sam pa ni opisan kot kralj. Ker je virov malo, o datumu, kraju in poteku bojev ni gotovosti, razen da so zmagali Briti.

source.title: Battle of Badon
paragraphs: The Battle of Badon, also known as the Battle of Mons Badonicus, was purportedly fought between Britons and Anglo-Saxons in Post-Roman Britain during the early 6th century. It was credited as a major victory for the Britons, stopping the westward encroachment of the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms for a period.

The earliest known references to the battle, by the British cleric Gildas, was written c. 543–547. It is chiefly known today for the involvement of the man who would later be remembered as the legendary King Arthur. His name is not known, although the name under the form "Arthur" first appears in the 9th-century Historia Brittonum, where he is mentioned as having participated in the battle alongside the Brittonic kings as a war commander, though is not described as a king himself. Because of the limited number of sources, there is no certainty about the date, location, or details of the fighting apart from the result being a victory for the Britons.

Battle of Baecula.headline: Bitka pri Baeculi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Baeculi je bila velika bitka na Iberskem polotoku v drugi punski vojni. Rimske republikanske sile in iberske pomožne enote pod poveljstvom Scipiona Afriškega so pognale v beg kartažansko vojsko Hasdrubala Barke.

source.title: Battle of Baecula
paragraphs: The Battle of Baecula was a major field battle in Iberia during the Second Punic War. Roman Republican and Iberian auxiliary forces under the command of Scipio Africanus routed the Carthaginian army of Hasdrubal Barca.

Battle of Bannockburn.headline: Bitka pri Bannockburnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bannockburnu (škotsko gelsko: Blàr Allt nam Bànag ali Blàr Allt a' Bhonnaich) je potekala 23. in 24. junija 1314 med vojsko škotskega kralja Roberta Brucea in vojsko angleškega kralja Edvarda II. v prvi škotski osamosvojitveni vojni. Robert Bruce je odločilno zmagal in bitka je pomenila veliko prelomnico vojne, ki se je 14 let pozneje končala z de iure obnovitvijo škotske neodvisnosti z edinburško-northamptonsko pogodbo. Zato bitko pri Bannockburnu splošno štejejo za mejnik škotske zgodovine.

source.title: Battle of Bannockburn
paragraphs: The Battle of Bannockburn (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Allt nam Bànag or Blàr Allt a' Bhonnaich) was fought on 23–24 June 1314, between the army of Robert the Bruce, King of Scots, and the army of King Edward II of England, during the First War of Scottish Independence. It was a decisive victory for Robert Bruce and formed a major turning point in the war, which ended 14 years later with the de jure restoration of Scottish independence under the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton. For this reason, the Battle of Bannockburn is widely considered a landmark moment in Scottish history.

Battle of Barnet.headline: Bitka pri Barnetu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Barnetu je bila odločilna zmaga Yorkov v vojni rož, dinastičnem spopadu v Angliji 15. stoletja. Skupaj s poznejšo bitko pri Tewkesburyju je Edvardu IV. zagotovila prestol.

V nedeljo, 14. aprila 1471, na veliko noč, je Edvard blizu Barneta, tedaj majhnega mesta v Hertfordshiru severno od Londona, vodil yorško hišo v boj proti lancastrski, ki je podpirala Henrika VI. Lancastrsko vojsko je vodil Richard Neville, grof Warwick, ki je odločilno vplival na usodo obeh kraljev. Zgodovinarji bitko štejejo za enega najpomembnejših spopadov vojne rož, saj je usodo obeh rodbin odločilno obrnila. Edvardovi zmagi je sledilo 14 let yorške vladavine v Angliji.

source.title: Battle of Barnet
paragraphs: The Battle of Barnet was a decisive Yorkist victory in the Wars of the Roses, a dynastic conflict of 15th-century England. The military action, along with the subsequent Battle of Tewkesbury, secured the throne for Edward IV.

On Sunday 14 April 1471, Easter Day, near Barnet, then a small Hertfordshire town north of London, Edward led the House of York in a fight against the House of Lancaster, which backed Henry VI for the throne. Leading the Lancastrian army was Richard Neville, Earl of Warwick, who played a crucial role in the fate of each king. Historians regard the battle as one of the most important clashes in the Wars of the Roses, since it brought about a decisive turn in the fortunes of the two houses. Edward's victory was followed by 14 years of Yorkist rule over England.

Bitka pri Beachy Head, znana tudi kot bitka pri Béveziersu, je bila pomorska bitka 10. julija 1690 v devetletni vojni. Bila je najpomembnejša francoska pomorska zmaga nad nasprotniki iz velike alianse v tej vojni. Nizozemci so izgubili sedem linijskih ladij in tri ladje požigalke, njihovi angleški zavezniki eno linijsko ladjo, Francozi pa niti ene. Nadzor nad Rokavskim prelivom je začasno prešel v francoske roke, vendar francoski viceadmiral Anne Hilarion de Tourville angleško-nizozemskega ladjevja ni zasledoval dovolj odločno, zato se je to lahko umaknilo na Temzo.

Tourvilla so kritizirali, ker zmage ni izkoristil, in ga razrešili poveljstva. Angleškemu admiralu Arthurju Herbertu, 1. grofu Torringtonu, ki je odsvetoval spopad z močnejšim francoskim ladjevjem, a so ga preglasili kraljica Marija II. in njeni ministri, so zaradi ravnanja v bitki sodili pred vojaškim sodiščem. Čeprav je bil oproščen, ga je kralj Viljem III. odpustil iz službe.

source.title: Battle of Beachy Head (1690)
paragraphs: The Battle of Beachy Head, also known as the Battle of Béveziers, was a fleet action fought on 10 July 1690 during the Nine Years' War. The battle was the most significant French naval victory over their Grand Alliance opponents during the war. The Dutch lost seven ships of the line and three fire ships. Their English allies also lost one ship of the line, whereas the French did not lose a single vessel. Control of the English Channel temporarily fell into French hands but French Vice-Admiral Anne Hilarion de Tourville failed to pursue the Anglo-Dutch fleet with sufficient vigour, allowing it to fall back to the Thames.

Tourville was criticised for not following up his victory and was relieved of his command. English Admiral Arthur Herbert, 1st Earl of Torrington, who had advised against engaging the superior French fleet but had been overruled by Queen Mary II and her ministers, was court-martialled for his performance during the battle. Although he was acquitted, King William III dismissed him from the service.

Battle of Belchite (1937).headline: Bitka pri Belchiteju (1937)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Belchiteju je ime za vrsto vojaških operacij, ki so med 24. avgustom in 7. septembrom 1937 potekale v mestu Belchite in okolici (leta 1936 je imelo skoraj 4000 prebivalcev, med bitko pa zaradi represije in razseljevanja v prvem letu vojne okoli 2600) v Aragoniji med špansko državljansko vojno, v okviru precej večje ofenzive za zavzetje Zaragoze, ki je trajala do začetka novembra 1937.

Ker je ofenziva na Zaragozo spodletela, so jo republikanci iz propagandnih razlogov začeli imenovati bitka pri Belchiteju, da bi bila videti kot zmaga, k spremembi imena pa so pripomogli tudi novinarji, ki so prišli poročat o zmagi, med njimi Ernest Hemingway. Nacionalisti so zmedo nadaljevali, saj so tudi sami propagandno izkoriščali »numantinsko« obrambo mesta, da bi z njo popravili slabo podobo bombardiranja Guernice.

source.title: Battle of Belchite (1937)
paragraphs: The Battle of Belchite refers to a series of military operations that took place between 24 August and 7 September 1937, in and around the town of Belchite (almost 4,000 inhabitants in 1936, decreasing to around 2,600 during the battle, from the repression and displacement of the first year), in Aragon during the Spanish Civil War, as part of a much bigger offensive to take Zaragoza, that continued until the beginning of November 1937.

Since the Offensive of Zaragoza failed, the Republicans started calling it Battle of Belchite for propaganda reasons instead, so that it would look like a victory, the journalists that came to report the victory, including Ernest Hemingway, contributed to this change of names. The Nationalists continued the confusion, since they exploited the "Numantine" defense of the town for propaganda too, to counteract the bad image of the bombing of Guernica.

Battle of Blore Heath.headline: Bitka pri Blore Heathu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Blore Heathu je potekala 23. septembra 1459 v angleški vojni rož pri Blore Heathu v Staffordshiru. Blore Heath je redko naseljeno območje kmetijskih zemljišč dve milji (približno tri kilometre) vzhodno od mesta Market Drayton v Shropshiru, blizu vasi Loggerheads v Staffordshiru.

source.title: Battle of Blore Heath
paragraphs: The Battle of Blore Heath took place during the English Wars of the Roses on 23 September 1459, at Blore Heath, Staffordshire. Blore Heath is a sparsely populated area of farmland two miles east of the town of Market Drayton in Shropshire, and close to the village of Loggerheads, Staffordshire.

Battle of Brihuega.headline: Bitka pri Brihuegi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brihuegi je potekala 8. decembra 1710 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo, med zavezniškim umikom iz Madrida proti Barceloni. Zaledno stražo britanske vojske pod vodstvom Jamesa Stanhopa, 1. grofa Stanhopa, je v mestu Brihuega odrezala, obkolila in nazadnje strla francosko-španska vojska pod poveljstvom Louisa Josepha, vojvode Vendômskega. Bitka je skupaj z drugimi dogodki končala britansko sodelovanje v vojni.

source.title: Battle of Brihuega
paragraphs: The Battle of Brihuega took place on 8 December 1710 in the War of the Spanish Succession, during the Allied retreat from Madrid to Barcelona. A British Army rearguard led by James Stanhope, 1st Earl Stanhope was cut off and trapped within the town of Brihuega before being overwhelmed by a Franco-Spanish army under the command of Louis Joseph, Duke of Vendôme. The battle, along with other events, brought an end to British participation in the war.

Battle of Brunanburh.headline: Bitka pri Brunanburhu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brunanburhu je potekala leta 937 med angleškim kraljem Æthelstanom in zavezništvom dublinskega kralja Olafa Guthfrithsona, škotskega kralja Konstantina II. in strathclydskega kralja Owaina. Bitko včasih navajajo kot izvor angleške narodne identitete: zgodovinarji, kot je Michael Livingston, trdijo, da so »možje, ki so se na tem polju bojevali in umirali, skovali politični zemljevid prihodnosti, ki je ostal, zato je bitka pri Brunanburhu morda ena najpomembnejših bitk v dolgi zgodovini ne le Anglije, temveč vseh Britanskih otokov«.

source.title: Battle of Brunanburh
paragraphs: The Battle of Brunanburh was fought in 937 between Æthelstan, King of England, and an alliance of Olaf Guthfrithson, King of Dublin; Constantine II, King of Scotland; and Owain, King of Strathclyde. The battle is sometimes cited as the point of origin for English national identity: historians such as Michael Livingston argue that "the men who fought and died on that field forged a political map of the future that remains, arguably making the Battle of Brunanburh one of the most significant battles in the long history not just of England, but of the whole of the British Isles."

Battle of Brunete.headline: Bitka pri Brunetu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brunetu (6.–25. julija 1937), ki je potekala 24 kilometrov zahodno od Madrida, je bila republikanski poskus, da bi v španski državljanski vojni zmanjšali pritisk nacionalistov na prestolnico in na sever. Republikanci so bili sprva uspešni, a so se morali po protinapadih nacionalistov z Bruneta umakniti in so v bitki utrpeli uničujoče izgube.
notes: The miles conversion (15 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Brunete
paragraphs: The Battle of Brunete (6–25 July 1937), fought 24 kilometres (15 mi) west of Madrid, was a Republican attempt to alleviate the pressure exerted by the Nationalists on the capital and on the north during the Spanish Civil War. Although initially successful, the Republicans were forced to retreat from Brunete after Nationalist counterattacks, and suffered devastating casualties from the battle.

Battle of Cabezón.headline: Bitka pri Cabezónu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cabezónu je bila spopad na začetku polotoške vojne 12. junija 1808 med špansko kastiljsko vojsko pod Cuesto s sedežem v Valladolidu in oddelki francoskega armadnega korpusa maršala Bessièresa pod generaloma Lasallom in Merlom. Lasalle je še isti večer brez odpora zasedel Valladolid.
Merlovo kolono je sestavljalo šest bataljonov in dva eskadrona, Lasallovo pa so sestavljali štirje bataljoni in dva polka lovcev.
Cuestove sile so sestavljali štirje topovi in 4000 ali 5000 prostovoljcev, ki niso bili pod orožjem več kot dva tedna, ter 300 konjenikov, njegove edine izkušene enote.

source.title: Battle of Cabezón
paragraphs: The Battle of Cabezón was an engagement early in the Peninsular War on 12 June 1808 between Spain's Army of Castile, under Cuesta, based at Valladolid, and detachments of Marshal Bessières' French Army Corps under generals General Lasalle and Merle. Lasalle occupied Valladolid without opposition that same evening.
Merle's column consisted of six battalions and two squadrons, while Lasalle's was made up of four battalions and two regiments of chasseurs.
Cuesta's forces consisted of four cannon and 4,000 or 5,000 volunteers, who had not been more than a fortnight under arms, plus 300 cavalry, his only veteran troops.

Battle of Cádiz (1702).headline: Bitka pri Cádizu (1702)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cádizu je bila poskus angleških in nizozemskih sil leta 1702, da bi v vojni za špansko nasledstvo zavzele južnošpansko pristanišče Cádiz. Andaluzijsko pristanišče Cádiz je bilo središče španske trgovine z ameriškimi kolonijami. Zavzetje pristanišča bi zato ne le pomagalo pretrgati vezi Španije z njenim imperijem v Ameriki, temveč bi zaveznikom dalo tudi strateško pomembno oporišče, iz katerega bi angleška in nizozemska mornarica lahko nadzorovali zahodno Sredozemsko morje.

Vojaške priprave so spremljali zavezniški diplomatski ukrepi na Portugalskem, s katerimi so portugalskega kralja Petra II. skušali pridobiti za pristop k veliki alianci. Zavezniki so v Španiji nameravali tudi pridobiti podporo za upor v imenu avstrijskega pretendenta za španski prestol, nadvojvode Karla. Bitka je bila prva v tej vojni na Iberskem polotoku, toda zaradi rivalstva med rodovi vojske, slabe discipline, slabega sodelovanja in spretne obrambe markiza Villadariasa admiral George Rooke cilja ni dosegel in je po mesecu dni odplul domov.

source.title: Battle of Cádiz (1702)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cádiz was an attempt by English and Dutch forces to seize the southern Spanish port of Cádiz in 1702 during the War of the Spanish Succession. The Andalusian port of Cádiz served as the centre of Spanish trade with its American colonies. As such, the port's capture would not only help to sever Spain's links with her empire in the Americas, but it would also provide the Allies with a strategically important base from which the English and Dutch navies could control the western Mediterranean Sea.

The military build-up was accompanied by Allied diplomatic measures in Portugal aimed at enticing King Peter II to join the Grand Alliance. The Allies also intended to garner support in Spain for an insurrection in the name of the Austrian pretender to the Spanish throne, the Archduke Charles. The battle was the first of the war in the Iberian Peninsula, but due to interservice rivalry, ill discipline, poor co-operation, and a skilful defence from the Marquis of Villadarias, Admiral George Rooke was unable to complete his objective and, after a month, he set sail for home.

Battle of Cape Finisterre (1805).headline: Bitka pri rtu Finisterre (1805)
paragraphs: V bitki pri rtu Finisterre (22. julija 1805) pred Galicijo v Španiji se je britansko ladjevje pod admiralom Robertom Calderjem v neodločeni pomorski bitki spopadlo z združenim francosko-španskim ladjevjem, ki se je vračalo iz Zahodne Indije. Britanci so zajeli dve španski linijski ladji, niso pa preprečili, da bi se ladjevje francoskega viceadmirala Pierra-Charlesa Villeneuva združilo z eskadro iz Ferrola, in niso zadali uničujočega udarca, ki bi Veliko Britanijo rešil nevarnosti invazije. Calderju so pozneje sodili pred vojaškim sodiščem in ga ostro grajali zaradi neuspeha in ker 23. in 24. julija ni obnovil spopada. Hkrati se je Villeneuve po bitki odločil, da ne bo nadaljeval proti Brestu, kjer bi se njegovo ladjevje lahko združilo z drugimi francoskimi ladjami in očistilo Rokavski preliv za invazijo na Veliko Britanijo.

source.title: Battle of Cape Finisterre (1805)
paragraphs: In the Battle of Cape Finisterre (22 July 1805) off Galicia, Spain, the British fleet under Admiral Robert Calder fought an indecisive naval battle against the combined Franco-Spanish fleet which was returning from the West Indies. In the ensuing battle the British captured two Spanish ships of the line, but failed to prevent the joining of French Vice-admiral Pierre-Charles Villeneuve's fleet to the squadron of Ferrol and to strike the shattering blow that would have freed Great Britain from the danger of an invasion. Calder was later court-martialled and severely reprimanded for his failure and for avoiding the renewal of the engagement on 23 and 24 July. At the same time, in the aftermath Villeneuve elected not to continue on to Brest, where his fleet could have joined with other French ships to clear the English Channel for an invasion of Great Britain.

Battle of Cape Ortegal.headline: Bitka pri rtu Ortegal
paragraphs: Bitka pri rtu Ortegal je bila zadnji spopad trafalgarske kampanje, v katerem sta se spopadli eskadra Kraljeve vojne mornarice in ostanek francoskega ladjevja, poraženega v bitki pri Trafalgarju. Potekala je 4. novembra 1805 pred rtom Ortegal na severozahodu Španije, kapitan sir Richard Strachan pa je v njej premagal in zajel francosko eskadro pod poveljstvom kontraadmirala Pierra Dumanoirja le Pelleyja. Včasih jo imenujejo Strachanov spopad.

source.title: Battle of Cape Ortegal
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape Ortegal was the final action of the Trafalgar campaign, and was fought between a squadron of the Royal Navy and a remnant of the French fleet that had been defeated earlier at the Battle of Trafalgar. It took place on 4 November 1805 off Cape Ortegal, in north-west Spain and saw Captain Sir Richard Strachan defeat and capture a French squadron under Counter-admiral Pierre Dumanoir le Pelley. It is sometimes referred to as Strachan's Action.

Bitka pri rtu São Vicente je bila pomorska bitka 14. februarja 1797 med britansko in špansko vojno mornarico pred rtom São Vicente na Portugalskem v vojni prve koalicije. V eni prvih bitk nedavno napovedane vojne med Britanijo in Španijo je britansko ladjevje pod admiralom modre zastave sirom Johnom Jervisom premagalo večje špansko ladjevje pod generalporočnikom Joséjem de Córdobo y Ramosom, ki je izplulo iz Cádiza, da bi se spopadlo z britansko mornarico. Komodor Horatio Nelson se je v bitki izkazal, ko je z abordažo zavzel dve španski linijski ladji.

source.title: Battle of Cape St. Vincent (1797)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape St. Vincent was a fleet action fought on 14 February 1797 between the British and Spanish navies off Cape St. Vincent in Portugal as part of the War of the First Coalition. In one of the opening battles of the recently declared war between Britain and Spain, a British fleet under Admiral of the Blue Sir John Jervis defeated a larger Spanish fleet under Lieutenant-general José de Córdoba y Ramos which had left Cádiz to confront the British navy. Commodore Horatio Nelson distinguished himself in the battle by boarding and capturing two Spanish ships of the line.

Battle of Chester.headline: Bitka pri Chestru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Chestru (starovaližansko: Guaith Caer Legion; valižansko: Brwydr Caer) je bila velika zmaga Anglosasov nad domačimi Briti blizu mesta Chester v Angliji v začetku 7. stoletja. Æthelfrith Northumbrijski je uničil združene sile valižanskih kraljestev Powys in Rhôs (kantrefa Kraljestva Gwynedd), morda pa tudi Mercie. V bitki so padli valižanska voditelja Selyf Sarffgadau iz Powysa in Cadwal Crysban iz Rhôsa ter številni drugi visoki bojevniki, kot je bil Gwion ap Cyndrwyn iz Pengwerna. Posredni dokazi kažejo, da je morda padel tudi gwyneddski kralj Iago. Po drugih virih je bitka morda potekala leta 613 ali celo že leta 607 ali 605 n. št.

Po Bedi so pred bitko po Æthelfrithovem ukazu pobili veliko menihov iz samostana Bangor on Dee, ki so prišli opazovat boj. Æthelfrith je bojevnikom ukazal, naj pokoljejo duhovnike, ker so ti, čeprav neoboroženi, molili za poraz Northumbrije.

source.title: Battle of Chester
paragraphs: The Battle of Chester (Old Welsh: Guaith Caer Legion; Welsh: Brwydr Caer) was a major victory for the Anglo-Saxons over the native Britons near the city of Chester, England in the early 7th century. Æthelfrith of Northumbria annihilated a combined force from the Welsh kingdoms of Powys and Rhôs (a cantref of the Kingdom of Gwynedd), and possibly from Mercia as well. It resulted in the deaths of Welsh leaders Selyf Sarffgadau of Powys, Cadwal Crysban of Rhôs, and numerous other high-ranking warriors such as Gwion ap Cyndrwyn of Pengwern. Circumstantial evidence suggests that King Iago of Gwynedd may have also been killed. Other sources state the battle may have been in 613 or even as early as 607 or 605 AD.

According to Bede, a large number of monks from the monastery at Bangor on Dee who had come to witness the fight were killed on the orders of Æthelfrith before the battle. He told his warriors to massacre the clerics because although they bore no arms, they were praying for a Northumbria defeat.

Battle of Cissa.headline: Bitka pri Cissi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cissi je bila del druge punske vojne. Potekala je jeseni 218 pr. n. št. blizu mesta Tarraco na severovzhodu Iberskega polotoka. Rimska vojska pod Gnejem Kornelijem Scipionom Kalvom je premagala številčno šibkejšo kartažansko vojsko pod Hanonom in tako prevzela nadzor nad ozemljem severno od reke Ebro, ki ga je Hanibal podjarmil le nekaj mesecev prej, poleti 218 pr. n. št. To je bila prva bitka, v kateri so se Rimljani kdaj bojevali na Iberskem polotoku.

Rimljanom je omogočila, da so si med prijateljskimi iberskimi plemeni ustvarili varno oporišče, in zaradi poznejšega uspeha bratov Scipionov v Hispaniji Hanibal med vojno ni nikoli dobil okrepitev iz Hispanije, čeprav jih je iskal.

source.title: Battle of Cissa
paragraphs: The Battle of Cissa was part of the Second Punic War. It was fought in the fall of 218 BC, near the town of Tarraco in north-eastern Iberia. A Roman army under Gnaeus Cornelius Scipio Calvus defeated an outnumbered Carthaginian army under Hanno, thus gaining control of the territory north of the Ebro River that Hannibal had just subdued a few months prior in the summer of 218 BC. This was the first battle that the Romans had ever fought in Iberia.

It allowed the Romans to establish a secure base among friendly Iberian tribes, and due to the eventual success of the Scipio brothers in Spain, Hannibal looked for but never received reinforcements from Spain during the war.

Battle of Clavijo.headline: Bitka pri Claviju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Claviju je bitka, ki je postala priljubljena tema španskega izročila o rekonkvisti. Zgodbe o njej so se prvič pojavile v 13. stoletju. Po teh zgodbah naj bi se blizu Clavija spopadli kristjani pod vodstvom Ramira I. Asturijskega in muslimani pod vodstvom kordobskega emirja. Zaradi Diccionario de historia de España (1968) in zgodovinopisne kritike Juana Francisca Masdeuja jo danes štejejo za legendarno bitko, ki naj bi jo v kronike v 13. stoletju vključil nadškof Rodrigo Jiménez de Rada, ki je mešal podatke iz drugih bitk iz različnih časov in krajev. Kljub temu so bitko slavili kot prvino oblikovanja španske narodne zgodovine in izvor romanja po Jakobovi poti.
notes: The English sentence about Rodrigo Jiménez de Rada is garbled ("in the 1200s that would include"); translated as meant, with "the 1200s" as the 13th century.

source.title: Battle of Clavijo
paragraphs: The Battle of Clavijo is a battle which became a popular theme of Spanish traditions regarding the Reconquista. Stories about the battle first arose in the 13th century. According to these stories, it was fought near Clavijo between Christians led by Ramiro I of Asturias and Muslims led by the Emir of Córdoba. The Diccionario de historia de España (1968) and the historiographical criticism of Juan Francisco Masdeu have made it be considered today a legendary battle, whose inclusion in the chronicles would be due to Archbishop Rodrigo Jiménez de Rada, in the 1200s that would include, mixing data from other battles of different times and locations. However, the battle was celebrated as an element of shaping Spanish national history and the origin of the pilgrimage of the way of Saint James.

Battle of Clontarf.headline: Bitka pri Clontarfu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Clontarfu (irsko: Cath Chluain Tarbh) je potekala 23. aprila 1014 pri Clontarfu blizu Dublina na vzhodni obali Irske. V njej se je vojska irskega velikega kralja Briana Boruja spopadla z nordijsko-irskim zavezništvom, ki so ga sestavljale sile dublinskega kralja Sigtrygga Svilenobradega, leinsterskega kralja Máela Mórde mac Murchade in vikinška vojska iz tujine pod vodstvom Sigurda Orkneyjskega in Brodirja z Mana. Trajala je od sončnega vzhoda do zahoda in se končala z begom vikinške in leinsterske vojske.

V bitki je po ocenah padlo med 7000 in 10.000 mož, med njimi večina voditeljev. Brianove sile so sicer zmagale, a je padel sam Brian, pa tudi njegov sin Murchad in vnuk Toirdelbach. Padli so tudi leinsterski kralj Máel Mórda ter vikinška voditelja Sigurd in Brodir. Po bitki je bila moč Vikingov in Dublinskega kraljestva v veliki meri strta.

source.title: Battle of Clontarf
paragraphs: The Battle of Clontarf (Irish: Cath Chluain Tarbh) took place on 23 April 1014 at Clontarf, near Dublin, on the east coast of Ireland. It pitted an army led by Brian Boru, High King of Ireland, against a Norse-Irish alliance comprising the forces of Sigtrygg Silkbeard, King of Dublin; Máel Mórda mac Murchada, King of Leinster; and a Viking army from abroad led by Sigurd of Orkney and Brodir of Mann. It lasted from sunrise to sunset, and ended in a rout of the Viking and Leinster armies.

It is estimated that between 7,000 and 10,000 men were killed in the battle, including most of the leaders. Although Brian's forces were victorious, Brian himself was killed, as were his son Murchad and his grandson Toirdelbach. Leinster king Máel Mórda and Viking leaders Sigurd and Brodir were also slain. After the battle, the power of the Vikings and the Kingdom of Dublin was largely broken.

Battle of Corunna.headline: Bitka pri La Coruñi
paragraphs: Bitka pri La Coruñi (tudi Corunna, A Coruña, La Corunna ali La Corogne), v Španiji znana kot bitka pri Elviñi, je potekala 16. januarja 1809, ko je francoski korpus pod maršalom cesarstva Jeanom de Dieu Soultom napadel britansko vojsko pod generalpodpolkovnikom sirom Johnom Moorom. Bitka je potekala med polotoško vojno, ki je bila del širših napoleonskih vojn.

Britanci so se pred Francozi pod Soultom, ki so jim bili trdovratno za petami, umikali čez severno Španijo, njihova zaledna straža pa je odbijala vedno nove francoske napade. Obe vojski sta trpeli zaradi ostre zime. Velik del britanske vojske, razen elitne lahke brigade pod Robertom Craufurdom, je med umikom izgubil red in disciplino. Ko so Britanci nekaj dni pred Francozi nazadnje prišli do pristanišča La Coruña na severni obali Galicije, prevoznih ladij še ni bilo. Ladjevje je prispelo čez nekaj dni in Britanci so se ravno vkrcavali, ko so napadle francoske sile.

source.title: Battle of Corunna
paragraphs: The Battle of Corunna (or A Coruña, La Corunna, La Coruña or La Corogne), in Spain known as Battle of Elviña, took place on 16 January 1809, when a French corps under Marshal of the Empire Jean de Dieu Soult attacked a British army under Lieutenant-General Sir John Moore. The battle took place during the Peninsular War, which was part of the wider Napoleonic Wars.

Doggedly pursued by the French under Soult, the British retreated across northern Spain while their rearguard fought off repeated French attacks. Both armies suffered from the harsh winter conditions. Much of the British army, excluding the elite Light Brigade under Robert Craufurd, suffered from a loss of order and discipline during the retreat. When the British eventually reached the port of Corunna on the northern coast of Galicia, a few days ahead of the French, they found their transport ships had not arrived. The fleet arrived after a couple of days and the British were embarking when the French forces attacked.

Battle of Culloden.headline: Bitka pri Cullodnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cullodnu je potekala 16. aprila 1746 blizu Invernessa v Škotskem višavju. Britanske vladne sile pod poveljstvom vojvode Cumberlandskega so odločilno premagale jakobitsko vojsko pod Charlesom Edwardom Stuartom in s tem končale jakobitski upor iz leta 1745.

Charles se je julija 1745 izkrcal na Škotskem, da bi na britanski prestol vrnil svojega očeta Jamesa Francisa Edwarda Stuarta. Hitro je zavzel velike dele Škotske, vdor v Anglijo pa je segel vse do Derbyja na jugu, preden se je moral obrniti nazaj. Do aprila 1746 pa je jakobitom primanjkovalo zalog, nasproti pa so imeli močnejšega in bolje opremljenega nasprotnika.

Jakobitski poveljniki so sklenili, da jim ne preostane drugega, kot da se postavijo v bran. Ko sta se vojski srečali pri Cullodnu, je bila bitka kratka, trajala je manj kot uro, jakobiti pa so doživeli popoln in krvav poraz. S tem sta se dejansko končala upor iz leta 1745 in jakobitstvo kot pomembna prvina britanske politike.

source.title: Battle of Culloden
paragraphs: The Battle of Culloden took place on 16 April 1746, near Inverness, in the Scottish Highlands. A Jacobite army under Charles Edward Stuart was decisively defeated by a British government force commanded by the Duke of Cumberland, thereby ending the Jacobite rising of 1745.

Charles landed in Scotland in July 1745, seeking to restore his father James Francis Edward Stuart to the British throne. He quickly won control of large parts of Scotland, and an invasion of England reached as far south as Derby before being forced to turn back. However by April 1746 the Jacobites were short of supplies, facing a superior and better-equipped opponent.

The Jacobite commanders decided their only option was to stand and fight. When the two armies met at Culloden, the battle was brief, lasting less than an hour, with the Jacobites suffering an overwhelming and bloody defeat. This effectively ended both the 1745 rising and Jacobitism as a significant element in British politics.

Battle of Deorham.headline: Bitka pri Deorhamu
paragraphs: Bitko pri Deorhamu (ali Dyrhamu) Anglosaška kronika prikazuje kot pomemben vojaški spopad med Zahodnimi Sasi in Briti na zahodu Anglije (West Country) leta 577. Kronika bitko opisuje kot veliko zmago wessexških sil pod vodstvom Ceawlina in nekega Cuthwina, ki so zavzele rimsko-britanska mesta Glevum (Gloucester), Corinium Dobunnorum (Cirencester) in Aquae Sulis (Bath).

source.title: Battle of Deorham
paragraphs: The Battle of Deorham (or Dyrham) is portrayed by the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle as an important military encounter between the West Saxons and the Britons in the West Country in 577. The Chronicle depicts the battle as a major victory for Wessex's forces, led by Ceawlin and one Cuthwine, resulting in the capture of the Romano-British towns of Glevum (Gloucester), Corinium Dobunnorum (Cirencester), and Aquae Sulis (Bath).

Battle of Dover (1652).headline: Bitka pri Dovru (1652)
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Dovru, ki je potekala 19. maja 1652 (29. maja 1652 po gregorijanskem koledarju), je bila prvi spopad prve angleško-nizozemske vojne med mornaricama Angleške republike in Republike Združenih Nizozemskih provinc. Bila je neodločena bitka, v kateri sta sodelovali admiralski ladji admiralov Maartena Trompa in Roberta Blaka. Zgodovinarji tega obdobja si o izidu bitke niso enotni.

source.title: Battle of Dover (1652)
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Dover, fought on 19 May 1652 (29 May 1652 Gregorian calendar), was the first engagement of the First Anglo-Dutch War between the navies of the Commonwealth of England and the United Provinces of the Netherlands. It proved to be an indecisive battle involving the flagships of Admirals Maarten Tromp and Robert Blake. Opinions about the outcome of that battle vary among historians of that period.

Battle of Dublin.headline: Bitka za Dublin
paragraphs: Bitka za Dublin je bila teden uličnih bojev v Dublinu od 28. junija do 5. julija 1922, s katerim se je začela irska državljanska vojna. Šest mesecev po tem, ko je anglo-irska pogodba končala irsko osamosvojitveno vojno, so se v njej spopadle sile nove začasne vlade in del Irske republikanske armade (IRA), ki je pogodbi nasprotoval.

V bitki je sodelovala tudi Irska državljanska vojska, ki je na območju ulice O'Connell podpirala del IRA, ki je nasprotoval pogodbi. Boji so se začeli z napadom sil začasne vlade na stavbo Four Courts in se končali z odločilno zmago začasne vlade.

source.title: Battle of Dublin
paragraphs: The Battle of Dublin was a week of street battles in Dublin from 28 June to 5 July 1922 that marked the beginning of the Irish Civil War. Six months after the Anglo-Irish Treaty ended the recent Irish War of Independence, it was fought between the forces of the new Provisional Government and a section of the Irish Republican Army (IRA) that opposed the Treaty.

The Irish Citizen Army also became involved in the battle, having supported the anti-Treaty IRA in the O'Connell Street area. The fighting began with an assault by Provisional Government forces on the Four Courts building, and ended in a decisive victory for the Provisional Government.

Battle of Dun Nechtain.headline: Bitka pri Dun Nechtainu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dun Nechtainu ali bitka pri Nechtansmeru (staroirsko: Cath Dúin Nechtáin; starovaližansko: Gueith Linn Garan) je potekala 20. maja 685 med Pikti pod vodstvom kralja Brideija Mac Bilija in Northumbrijci pod vodstvom kralja Ecgfritha.

Northumbrijska prevlada nad severno Britanijo, ki so jo izbojevali Ecgfrithovi predhodniki, je začela razpadati. Več podložnih ljudstev Northumbrije se je v zadnjih letih uprlo, kar je privedlo do vrste velikih bitk proti Piktom, Mercijcem in Ircem z različnim uspehom. Potem ko so Pikti oblegali sosednja ozemlja, je Ecgfrith kljub nasprotnim nasvetom povedel svoje sile nadnje, da bi znova uveljavil nadoblast nad piktskimi ljudstvi.

Pikti so z navideznim umikom zvabili Northumbrijce v zasedo pri Dun Nechtainu blizu jezera Linn Garan. Dolgo so menili, da je bojišče blizu današnje vasi Dunnichen v Angusu. Novejše raziskave pa kažejo na severnejšo lokacijo blizu Dunachtona na obali jezera Loch Insh v pokrajini Badenoch and Strathspey.

source.title: Battle of Dun Nechtain
paragraphs: The Battle of Dun Nechtain or Battle of Nechtansmere (Old Irish: Cath Dúin Nechtáin; Old Welsh: Gueith Linn Garan) was fought between the Picts, led by King Bridei Mac Bili, and the Northumbrians, led by King Ecgfrith, on 20 May 685.

The Northumbrian hegemony over northern Britain, won by Ecgfrith's predecessors, had begun to disintegrate. Several of Northumbria's subject nations had rebelled in recent years, leading to a number of large-scale battles against the Picts, Mercians and Irish, with varied success. After sieges of neighbouring territories carried out by the Picts, Ecgfrith led his forces against them, despite advice to the contrary, in an effort to reassert his suzerainty over the Pictish nations.

A feigned retreat by the Picts drew the Northumbrians into an ambush at Dun Nechtain near the lake of Linn Garan. The battle site has long been thought to have been near the present-day village of Dunnichen in Angus. Recent research, however, has suggested a more northerly location near Dunachton, on the shores of Loch Insh in Badenoch and Strathspey.

Battle of Dunbar (1296).headline: Bitka pri Dunbarju (1296)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dunbarju je bila edini pomembnejši spopad na bojnem polju v pohodu leta 1296 na začetku prve škotske osamosvojitvene vojne.

source.title: Battle of Dunbar (1296)
paragraphs: The Battle of Dunbar was the only significant field action of the campaign of 1296 during the beginning of the First War of Scottish Independence.

Battle of Dunbar (1650).headline: Bitka pri Dunbarju (1650)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dunbarju je potekala 3. septembra 1650 blizu Dunbarja na Škotskem med angleško vojsko novega kova (New Model Army) pod Oliverjem Cromwellom in škotsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Davida Leslieja. Angleži so odločilno zmagali. Bila je prva večja bitka vdora na Škotsko leta 1650.

source.title: Battle of Dunbar (1650)
paragraphs: The Battle of Dunbar was fought between the English New Model Army, under Oliver Cromwell, and a Scottish army commanded by David Leslie on 3 September 1650 near Dunbar, Scotland. The battle resulted in a decisive victory for the English. It was the first major battle of the 1650 invasion of Scotland.

Battle of Dungeness.headline: Bitka pri Dungenessu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Dungenessu je potekala 30. novembra 1652 (10. decembra po gregorijanskem koledarju) v prvi angleško-nizozemski vojni blizu rta Dungeness v Kentu.

source.title: Battle of Dungeness
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Dungeness took place on 30 November 1652 (10 December in the Gregorian calendar) during the First Anglo-Dutch War near the cape of Dungeness in Kent.

Battle of Dupplin Moor.headline: Bitka pri Dupplin Mooru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dupplin Mooru je potekala 11. avgusta 1332 med privrženci škotskega kralja Davida II., sina kralja Roberta Brucea, in napadalci, ki jih je podpirala Anglija in so podpirali Edvarda Balliola, sina škotskega kralja Ivana I. Spopad je potekal malo jugozahodno od Pertha na Škotskem, ko je škotska vojska pod poveljstvom Donalda, grofa Mara, ki je po ocenah štela več kot 15.000 in morda celo 40.000 mož, napadla pretežno angleško vojsko 1500 mož pod poveljstvom Balliola in Henryja Beaumonta, grofa Buchana. Bila je prva večja bitka druge škotske osamosvojitvene vojne.

source.title: Battle of Dupplin Moor
paragraphs: The Battle of Dupplin Moor was fought between supporters of King David II of Scotland, the son of King Robert Bruce, and English-backed invaders supporting Edward Balliol, son of King John I of Scotland, on 11 August 1332. It took place a little to the south-west of Perth, Scotland, when a Scottish force commanded by Donald, Earl of Mar, estimated to have been stronger than 15,000 and possibly as many as 40,000 men, attacked a largely English force of 1,500 commanded by Balliol and Henry Beaumont, Earl of Buchan. This was the first major battle of the Second War of Scottish Independence.

Battle of Ebro River.headline: Bitka pri reki Ebro
paragraphs: Bitka pri reki Ebro je bila pomorska bitka spomladi 217 pr. n. št. blizu ustja reke Ebro med kartažanskim ladjevjem s približno 40 kvinkveremami pod poveljstvom Himilka in rimskim ladjevjem s 35 ladjami pod Gnejem Kornelijem Scipionom Kalvom. Hasdrubal Barka, kartažanski poveljnik na Iberskem polotoku, je sprožil skupen pohod, da bi uničil rimsko oporišče severno od reke Ebro. Kartažanski pomorski oddelek je bil po presenetljivem napadu rimskih ladij popolnoma poražen: izgubil je 29 ladij in nadzor nad morji okoli Iberskega polotoka. Po tej zmagi je ugled Rimljanov na Iberskem polotoku še zrasel, zato so se uprla nekatera iberska plemena pod kartažansko oblastjo.

source.title: Battle of Ebro River
paragraphs: The Battle of Ebro River was a naval battle fought near the mouth of Ebro River in the spring of 217 BC between a Carthaginian fleet of approximately 40 quinqueremes, under the command of Himilco, and a Roman fleet of 35 ships, under Gnaeus Cornelius Scipio Calvus. Hasdrubal Barca, the Carthaginian commander in Iberia, had launched a joint expedition to destroy the Roman base north of the Ebro River. The Carthaginian naval contingent was totally defeated after a surprise attack by the Roman ships, losing 29 ships and the control of seas around Iberia. The reputation of the Romans was further enhanced in Iberia after this victory, causing rebellion among some of the Iberian tribes under Carthaginian control.

Battle of Edgcote.headline: Bitka pri Edgcotu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Edgcotu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Banburyju ali bitka pri Danes Mooru) je potekala 24. julija 1469 v vojni rož. V njej sta se spopadli kraljeva vojska pod poveljstvom grofov Pembroka in Devona ter uporniška vojska, ki so jo vodili privrženci grofa Warwicka.

Bitka je potekala 9,7 kilometra severovzhodno od Banburyja v Oxfordshiru in se končala z zmago upornikov, ki je oblast začasno prepustila grofu Warwicku. Septembra pa je angleški kralj Edvard IV. znova prevzel nadzor in Warwick se je znašel v podobnem položaju kot pred bitko, zato je začel načrtovati drugi upor. Po Edgcotu ni bilo več poti nazaj. Edvard mu ni mogel več povsem zaupati, Warwick pa se je neizprosno približeval lancastrski strani.
notes: The miles (6 mi) are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Edgcote
paragraphs: The Battle of Edgcote (also known as the Battle of Banbury or the Battle of Danes Moor) took place on 24 July 1469, during the Wars of the Roses. It was fought between a royal army, commanded by the earls of Pembroke and Devon, and a rebel force led by supporters of the Earl of Warwick.

The battle took place 6 miles (9.7 km) northeast of Banbury in Oxfordshire; it resulted in a rebel victory which temporarily handed power over to the Earl of Warwick. By September, though, Edward IV of England was back in control, and Warwick found himself in a situation similar to the one before the battle, prompting him to plan a second rebellion. After Edgcote there was no turning back. Edward could no longer trust him fully and he was inexorably moving towards becoming a Lancastrian.

Battle of Edgehill.headline: Bitka pri Edgehillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Edgehillu (ali Edge Hillu) je bila redna bitka prve angleške državljanske vojne. Potekala je v nedeljo, 23. oktobra 1642, blizu Edge Hilla in Kinetona v južnem Warwickshiru.

Vsi poskusi ustavnega kompromisa med kraljem Karlom in parlamentom so v začetku leta 1642 propadli. Kralj in parlament sta zbrala veliki vojski, da bi svoje dosegla z orožjem. Oktobra se je kralj v začasnem oporišču blizu Shrewsburyja odločil, da bo krenil proti Londonu in tako izsilil odločilni spopad z glavno parlamentarno vojsko pod poveljstvom grofa Essexa.

Pozno 22. oktobra sta obe vojski nepričakovano ugotovili, da je sovražnik blizu. Naslednji dan se je rojalistična vojska spustila z Edge Hilla, da bi izsilila bitko. Ko je parlamentarna artilerija začela obstreljevanje, so rojalisti napadli. Obe vojski so sestavljali večinoma neizkušeni in včasih slabo opremljeni vojaki. Veliko mož z obeh strani je pobegnilo ali se odcepilo, da bi plenili sovražnikovo prtljago, in nobena vojska ni dosegla odločilne prednosti.

source.title: Battle of Edgehill
paragraphs: The Battle of Edgehill (or Edge Hill) was a pitched battle of the First English Civil War. It was fought near Edge Hill and Kineton in southern Warwickshire on Sunday, 23 October 1642.

All attempts at constitutional compromise between King Charles and Parliament broke down early in 1642. Both the King and Parliament raised large armies to gain their way by force of arms. In October, at his temporary base near Shrewsbury, the King decided to march to London in order to force a decisive confrontation with Parliament's main army, commanded by the Earl of Essex.

Late on 22 October, both armies unexpectedly found the enemy to be close by. The next day, the Royalist army descended from Edge Hill to force battle. After the Parliamentarian artillery opened a cannonade, the Royalists attacked. Both armies consisted mostly of inexperienced and sometimes ill-equipped troops. Many men from both sides fled or fell out to loot enemy baggage, and neither army was able to gain a decisive advantage.

Battle of Edington.headline: Bitka pri Edingtonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Edingtonu ali bitka pri Ethandunu je potekala maja 878 med zahodnosaško vojsko kralja Alfreda Velikega in veliko pogansko vojsko pod vodstvom danskega vojskovodje Guthruma. Bitka je potekala blizu Edingtona v Wiltshiru, kjer je Alfred dosegel odločilno zmago, ki je ustavila vikinško prodiranje v Wessex.

Spopad je sledil obdobju nenehnih danskih vpadov na anglosaško ozemlje. V začetku leta 878 je Guthrum presenetljivo napadel Chippenham, zato se je moral Alfred skriti v močvirjih Athelneyja. Ko je zbral krajevne sile, se je z Guthrumom spopadel in ga premagal pri Edingtonu, nato pa oblegal vikinški položaj in Vikinge prisilil k predaji.

Po bitki je Guthrum privolil v pogoje, med katerimi so bili njegov krst, umik v Vzhodno Anglijo in sklenitev miru z wedmorsko pogodbo. Izid je ohranil Wessex kot samostojno kraljestvo in pomenil prelomnico vikinških vojn, saj je postavil temelje za poznejšo združitev Anglije.

source.title: Battle of Edington
