paragraphs: The Battle of Edington or Battle of Ethandun was fought in May 878 between the West Saxon army of King Alfred the Great and the Great Heathen Army led by the Danish warlord Guthrum. The battle took place near Edington in Wiltshire, where Alfred secured a decisive victory that halted the Viking advance into Wessex.

The engagement followed a period of sustained Danish incursions into Anglo-Saxon territory. In early 878, Guthrum launched a surprise attack on Chippenham, forcing Alfred into hiding in the marshes of Athelney. After rallying local forces, Alfred confronted and defeated Guthrum at Edington, then laid siege to the Viking position, compelling their surrender.

Following the battle, Guthrum agreed to terms that included his baptism, withdrawal to East Anglia, and the establishment of peace through the Treaty of Wedmore. The outcome preserved Wessex as an independent kingdom and marked a turning point in the Viking wars, laying foundations for the eventual unification of England.

Battle of Ellendun.headline: Bitka pri Ellendunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ellendunu ali bitka pri Wroughtonu je potekala septembra 825 med wessexškim kraljem Ecgberhtom in mercijskim kraljem Beornwulfom. Sir Frank Stenton jo je opisal kot »eno najbolj odločilnih bitk angleške zgodovine«. Z njo se je začela prevlada Zahodnih Sasov v južni Angliji.

source.title: Battle of Ellendun
paragraphs: The Battle of Ellendun or Battle of Wroughton was fought between Ecgberht of Wessex and Beornwulf of Mercia in September 825. Sir Frank Stenton described it as "one of the most decisive battles of English history". It began the establishment of West Saxon dominance in southern England.

Battle of Englefield.headline: Bitka pri Englefieldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Englefieldu je bila zmaga Zahodnih Sasov nad dansko vikinško vojsko okoli 31. decembra 870 pri Englefieldu blizu Readinga v Berkshiru. Bila je prva v vrsti bitk po vdoru danske vojske v Wessex decembra 870.

Do leta 870 so Vikingi osvojili dve od štirih anglosaških kraljestev, Northumbrijo in Vzhodno Anglijo. Konec leta 870 so poskusili osvojiti Wessex in iz Vzhodne Anglije krenili proti Readingu, kamor so prispeli okoli 28. decembra. Tri dni pozneje so pod vodstvom dveh jarlov poslali velik oddelek, da bi nabiral hrano in izvidoval, pri Englefieldu pa ga je pričakala vojska krajevnih vpoklicancev pod poveljstvom Æthelwulfa, ealdormana Berkshira. Ko je eden od jarlov padel in je bil velik del danske vojske strt, so se Vikingi razbežali.

source.title: Battle of Englefield
paragraphs: The Battle of Englefield was a West Saxon victory against a Danish Viking army on about 31 December 870 at Englefield, near Reading in Berkshire. It was the first of a series of battles that took place following an invasion of Wessex by the Danish army in December 870.

By 870, the Vikings had conquered two of the four Anglo-Saxon kingdoms, Northumbria and East Anglia. At the end of 870 they launched an attempt to conquer Wessex and marched from East Anglia to Reading, arriving on about 28 December. Three days later they sent out a large party under two earls to forage and reconnoitre, and it was met at Englefield by an army of local levies under the command of Æthelwulf, Ealdorman of Berkshire. After one of the earls was killed and a large part of the Danish army was overthrown, the Viking force broke and ran.

Battle of Espinosa de los Monteros.headline: Bitka pri Espinosi de los Monteros
paragraphs: Bitka pri Espinosi de los Monteros je potekala med napoleonskimi vojnami 10. in 11. novembra 1808 pri vasi Espinosa de los Monteros v Kantabrijskem gorovju. Končala se je z zmago Francozov pod maršalom Victorjem nad galicijsko vojsko generalporočnika Joaquína Blaka.

source.title: Battle of Espinosa de los Monteros
paragraphs: The Battle of Espinosa de los Monteros took place during the Napoleonic Wars, on 10 and 11 November 1808 at the village of Espinosa de los Monteros in the Cantabrian Mountains. It resulted in a French victory under Marshal Victor against Lieutenant General Joaquín Blake's Army of Galicia.

Battle of Evesham.headline: Bitka pri Eveshamu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Eveshamu (4. avgusta 1265) je bila ena od dveh glavnih bitk druge baronske vojne v Angliji 13. stoletja. Poznejši kralj Edvard I., ki je vodil sile svojega očeta, kralja Henrika III., je v njej premagal Simona de Montforta, grofa Leicestra, in uporne barone. Potekala je 4. avgusta 1265 blizu mesta Evesham v Worcestershiru.

Z bitko pri Lewesu je de Montfort pridobil nadzor nad kraljevo vlado, a ko je več bližnjih zaveznikov prestopilo na drugo stran in je princ Edvard pobegnil iz ujetništva, se je znašel v obrambi. Pri Eveshamu se je moral spopasti z rojalisti in se znašel pred dvakrat večjo vojsko od svoje. Bitka se je kmalu sprevrgla v pokol; de Montfort je padel, njegovo truplo pa so pohabili. Takratni zgodovinar Robert iz Gloucestra jo je opisal kot »umor v Eveshamu, kajti bitka to ni bila«. Bitka je sicer dejansko obnovila kraljevo oblast, vendar se je razpršen odpor nadaljeval vse do podpisa kenilworthske razsodbe leta 1267.

source.title: Battle of Evesham
paragraphs: The Battle of Evesham (4 August 1265) was one of the two main battles of 13th century England's Second Barons' War. It marked the defeat of Simon de Montfort, Earl of Leicester, and the rebellious barons by the future King Edward I, who led the forces of his father, King Henry III. It took place on 4 August 1265, near the town of Evesham, Worcestershire.

With the Battle of Lewes, de Montfort had won control of royal government, but after the defection of several close allies and the escape from captivity of Prince Edward, he found himself on the defensive. Forced to engage the royalists at Evesham, he faced an army twice the size of his own. The battle soon turned into a massacre; de Montfort himself was killed and his body mutilated. It was described by the contemporary historian Robert of Gloucester as the "murder of Evesham, for battle it was none". Though the battle effectively restored royal authority, scattered resistance remained until the Dictum of Kenilworth was signed in 1267.

Battle of Falkirk.headline: Bitka pri Falkirku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Falkirku (škotsko gelsko: Blàr na h-Eaglaise Brice; škotsko: Battle o Fawkirk) 22. julija 1298 je bila ena od velikih bitk prve škotske osamosvojitvene vojne. Angleška vojska pod vodstvom angleškega kralja Edvarda I. je premagala Škote, ki jih je vodil William Wallace. Kmalu po bitki je Wallace odstopil kot varuh Škotske.

source.title: Battle of Falkirk
paragraphs: The Battle of Falkirk (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr na h-Eaglaise Brice; Scots: Battle o Fawkirk), on 22 July 1298, was one of the major battles in the First War of Scottish Independence. Led by King Edward I of England, the English army defeated the Scots, led by William Wallace. Shortly after the battle Wallace resigned as Guardian of Scotland.

Battle of Ferrybridge.headline: Bitka pri Ferrybridgeu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ferrybridgeu 28. marca 1461 je bila predhodni spopad med hišama York in Lancaster pred večjo bitko pri Towtonu, v obdobju, ki ga danes imenujemo vojna rož.

source.title: Battle of Ferrybridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Ferrybridge, 28 March 1461, was a preliminary engagement between the houses of York and Lancaster before the larger battle of Towton, during the period now known as the Wars of the Roses.

Battle of Flodden.headline: Bitka pri Floddnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Floddnu, imenovana tudi bitka na polju Flodden ali občasno bitka pri Branxtonu ali Brainston Mooru, je potekala 9. septembra 1513 med Kraljevino Anglijo in Kraljevino Škotsko v vojni Cambraijske lige in se končala z angleško zmago. Bitka je potekala blizu Branxtona v grofiji Northumberland na severu Anglije med škotsko vojsko kralja Jakoba IV., ki je vdrla v Anglijo, in angleško vojsko pod poveljstvom grofa Surreyja. Po številu vojakov je bila največja bitka med kraljestvoma.

Jakob je oblegal in zavzel več angleških obmejnih gradov, nato pa se je z vojsko utaboril na nadvladujočem položaju na griču pri Floddnu, počakal angleško vojsko, poslano nadenj, in zavrnil izziv na boj na odprtem polju. Surreyjeva vojska je zato z obhodnim pohodom prišla v hrbet škotskemu taboru. Škoti so odgovorili tako, da so tabor zapustili in zasedli sosednji grič Branxton Hill, da ga ne bi zasedli Angleži.

source.title: Battle of Flodden
paragraphs: The Battle of Flodden, Flodden Field, or occasionally Branxton or Brainston Moor was fought on 9 September 1513 between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland as part of the War of the League of Cambrai and resulted in an English victory. The battle was fought near Branxton, in the county of Northumberland, in northern England, between an invading Scots army under King James IV and an English army commanded by the Earl of Surrey. In terms of troop numbers, it was the largest battle ever fought between the two kingdoms.

After besieging and capturing several English border castles, James encamped his invading army on a commanding hilltop position at Flodden, awaited the English force that had been sent against him, and declined a challenge to fight in an open field. Surrey's army, therefore, carried out a circuitous march to position themselves in the rear of the Scottish camp. The Scots countered that by abandoning their camp and occupying the adjacent Branxton Hill and denying it to the English.

Battle of Formentera.headline: Bitka pri Formenteri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Formenteri je potekala 28. oktobra 1529, ko je osmansko ladjevje pod Aydinom Reisom pred otokom Formentera blizu Ibize zajelo majhno špansko ladjevje osmih galej.
notes: The English text spells the island Formentara once; the Slovenian uses Formentera.

source.title: Battle of Formentera
paragraphs: The Battle of Formentara occurred on 28 October 1529 when an Ottoman fleet under Aydin Reis captured a small Spanish fleet of eight galleys off the island of Formentera near Ibiza.

Bitka za Frago je bila bitka španske rekonkviste, ki je potekala 17. julija 1134 pri Fragi v Aragoniji v Španiji. V njej so se združene sile kralja Alfonza Bojevnika in vikonta Centula VI. iz Béarna spopadle z različnimi almoravidskimi silami, ki so prišle na pomoč mestu Fraga, ki ga je Alfonz oblegal. Bitka se je končala z zmago Almoravidov. Aragonski kralj Alfonz je kmalu po bitki umrl.

source.title: Battle of Fraga
paragraphs: The Battle of Fraga was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista that took place on 17 July 1134 at Fraga, Aragon, Spain. The battle was fought between the combined forces of King Alfonso the Battler and Viscount Centule VI of Béarn, and a variety of Almoravid forces that had come to the aid of the town of Fraga which was being besieged by Alfonso. The battle resulted in an Almoravid victory. The Aragonese monarch Alfonso died shortly after the battle.

Battle of Fulford.headline: Bitka pri Fulfordu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fulfordu je potekala 20. septembra 1066 na obrobju vasi Fulford tik južno od Yorka v Angliji. Norveški kralj Harald III., znan tudi kot Harald Hardrada, pretendent za angleški prestol, in njegov angleški zaveznik Tostig Godwinson sta premagala severna grofa Edwina in Morcarja.

Hardradovo vojsko so sestavljali zavezniki z Orkneyja in oddelek, ki je prišel s Tostigom, ter možje z Norveške. Morje so prečkali z ladjevjem in si oporišče uredili južno od Yorka pri Riccallu. Vikingi so 20. septembra 1066 krenili proti Yorku. Pretežno neizkušena saška vojska, ki sta jo vodila Morcar iz Yorka in Edwin iz Tadcastra, jim je skušala zapreti pot. Po Anglosaški kroniki sta se nasprotni vojski srečali na vzhodnem bregu reke Ouse in Sasi so vikinški vojski sprva prizadejali hude izgube. Nordijska vojska je saško nazadnje strla, a sta grofa poraz preživela. Zmagoviti Norvežani so nato vkorakali v York, zbrali zaloge in zahtevali talce.

source.title: Battle of Fulford
paragraphs: The Battle of Fulford was fought on the outskirts of the village of Fulford, just south of York in England, on 20 September 1066. King Harald III of Norway, also known as Harald Hardrada, a claimant to the English throne, and Tostig Godwinson, his English ally, fought and defeated the Northern Earls Edwin and Morcar.

Hardrada's army consisted of allies from Orkney and a contingent with Tostig, as well as those coming from Norway. They crossed the sea in a fleet of ships and made their base south of York at Riccall. On 20 September 1066 the Vikings advanced towards York. The largely inexperienced Saxon army led by Morcar at York and Edwin at Tadcaster moved to block the invaders. The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle says that the opposing armies met on the east bank of the River Ouse and that initially the Saxons caused heavy losses on the Viking army. Ultimately, the Norse army overwhelmed the Saxon army although the earls themselves survived this defeat. After winning, the victorious Norwegians entered York, gathered supplies, and asked for hostages.

Battle of Glen Shiel.headline: Bitka pri Glen Shielu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Glen Shielu 10. junija 1719 je bila odločilni vojaški spopad jakobitskega upora leta 1719. Britanske vladne enote so blizu Glen Shiela v Škotskem višavju premagale jakobitsko vojsko, sestavljeno iz višavskih vpoklicancev in španskih marincev.

Upor je podpirala Španija, ki je bila tedaj z Britanijo v vojni četverne zveze (1718–1720). Prvotno naj bi bil le odvračalni manever za izkrcanje na jugozahodu Anglije, ki so ga nekaj tednov prej odpovedali, njegov neuspeh pa je po splošnem mnenju usodno škodoval jakobitski stvari.
Bojišče je danes vpisano v Popis zgodovinskih bojišč na Škotskem in ga varuje ustanova Historic Scotland.

source.title: Battle of Glen Shiel
paragraphs: The Battle of Glen Shiel, 10 June 1719, was the decisive military engagement of the Jacobite rising of 1719. Fought near Glen Shiel in the Scottish Highlands, a Jacobite army composed of Highland levies and Spanish marines was defeated by British government troops.

The rebellion was backed by Spain, then engaged in the 1718–1720 War of the Quadruple Alliance with Britain. Originally intended only as a diversion for a landing in south-west England which was cancelled several weeks earlier, its failure was seen as having fatally damaged the Jacobite cause.
The battlefield is now included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland, and protected by Historic Scotland.

Battle of Graus.headline: Bitka pri Grausu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Grausu je bila bitka rekonkviste, ki naj bi po izročilu potekala 8. maja 1063. V bitki ali zaradi nje je umrl aragonski kralj Ramiro I.
Antonio Ubieto Arteta je bitko v svojem delu Historia de Aragón datiral v leto 1069. Chronica naierensis iz poznega 12. stoletja spopad datira v leto 1070.

source.title: Battle of Graus
paragraphs: The Battle of Graus was a battle of the Reconquista, traditionally said to have taken place on 8 May 1063. Either in or as a result of the battle, King Ramiro I of Aragon died.
Antonio Ubieto Arteta, in his Historia de Aragón, re-dated the battle to 1069. The late twelfth-century Chronica naierensis dates the encounter to 1070.

Battle of Guadalacete.headline: Bitka pri Guadalaceteju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Guadalaceteju je potekala leta 852 med koalicijo enot Kraljestva Asturija in Kraljestva Pamplona ter enotami umajadskega muslimanskega Kordobskega emirata pod poveljstvom kordobskega emirja Mohameda I. Zmagali so Umajadi.

source.title: Battle of Guadalacete
paragraphs: The Battle of Guadalacete was fought in 852 between a coalition of troops from the Kingdom of Asturias and the Kingdom of Pamplona, and a force of troops from the Umayyad Muslim Emirate of Córdoba under the command of Muhammad I of Córdoba. The outcome was a Umayyad victory.

Battle of Guadalajara.headline: Bitka pri Guadalajari
paragraphs: V bitki pri Guadalajari (8.–23. marca 1937) sta Španska republikanska vojska (Ejército Popular Republicano, EPR) in mednarodne brigade premagali italijanske in nacionalistične sile, ki so v španski državljanski vojni skušale obkoliti Madrid. Nacionalistične sile v bitki pri Guadalajari so bile predvsem italijanski Korpus prostovoljnih enot (Corpo Truppe Volontarie, CTV).

Bitka se je začela z italijansko ofenzivo 8. marca, ki so jo do 11. marca ustavili. Med 12. in 14. marcem so ponovne italijanske napade podprle španske nacionalistične enote, a so jih prav tako ustavili. Republikanci so 15. marca pripravili protiofenzivo in jo med 18. in 23. marcem uspešno sprožili. Bitko je odločila premoč sovjetskih oklepnih vozil nad italijanskimi.

source.title: Battle of Guadalajara
paragraphs: The Battle of Guadalajara (8–23 March 1937) saw the victory of the Spanish Republican Army (Ejército Popular Republicano, or EPR) and of the International Brigades over the Italian and Nationalist forces attempting to encircle Madrid during the Spanish Civil War. The Nationalist forces involved in the Battle of Guadalajara were primarily the Italian Corps of Volunteer Troops (Corpo Truppe Volontarie, or CTV).

The battle opened with an Italian offensive on 8 March. This offensive was halted by 11 March. Between 12 and 14 March, renewed Italian attacks were supported by Spanish Nationalist units. These were halted too. On 15 March, a counter-offensive of the Republicans was prepared; it was successfully launched between 18 and 23 March. The battle was decided by the superiority of Soviet armoured vehicles over Italian ones.

Battle of Halidon Hill.headline: Bitka pri Halidon Hillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Halidon Hillu je potekala 19. julija 1333, ko je škotska vojska pod sirom Archibaldom Douglasom napadla angleško vojsko pod poveljstvom angleškega kralja Edvarda III. (vladal 1327–1377) in doživela hud poraz. Leto prej je Edvard Balliol ob prikriti podpori Edvarda III. petletnemu Davidu II. (vladal 1329–1371) odvzel škotsko krono. S tem se je začela druga škotska osamosvojitvena vojna. Balliola je kmalu iz Škotske pregnala ljudska vstaja, ki jo je Edvard III. izkoristil kot casus belli in leta 1333 vdrl na Škotsko. Neposredni cilj je bilo strateško pomembno obmejno mesto Berwick-upon-Tweed, ki so ga Angleži marca oblegali.

source.title: Battle of Halidon Hill
paragraphs: The Battle of Halidon Hill took place on 19 July 1333 when a Scottish army under Sir Archibald Douglas attacked an English army commanded by King Edward III of England (r. 1327–1377) and was heavily defeated. The year before, Edward Balliol had seized the Scottish Crown from five-year-old David II (r. 1329–1371), surreptitiously supported by Edward III. This marked the start of the Second War of Scottish Independence. Balliol was shortly expelled from Scotland by a popular uprising, which Edward III used as a casus belli, invading Scotland in 1333. The immediate target was the strategically-important border town of Berwick-upon-Tweed, which the English besieged in March.

Battle of Hatfield Chase.headline: Bitka pri Hatfield Chaseu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hatfield Chaseu (staroangleško: Hæðfeld; starovaližansko: Meigen) je potekala 12. oktobra 633. V njej so se Northumbrijci spopadli z zavezništvom Gwynedda in Mercie. Northumbrijce je vodil Edwin, gwyneddsko-mercijsko zavezništvo pa Cadwallon ap Cadfan in Penda. Bojišče je bilo močvirnato območje približno 13 kilometrov severovzhodno od Doncastra na južnem bregu reke Don, čeprav je ta lokacija sporna. Gwynedd in Mercijci so odločilno zmagali: Edwin je padel, njegova vojska je bila poražena, Northumbrija pa je začasno razpadla.
notes: The miles (8 mi) are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Hatfield Chase
paragraphs: The Battle of Hatfield Chase (Old English: Hæðfeld; Old Welsh: Meigen) was fought on 12 October 633 It pitted the Northumbrians against an alliance of Gwynedd and Mercia. The Northumbrians were led by Edwin and the Gwynedd-Mercian alliance was led by Cadwallon ap Cadfan and Penda. The site of the battle was a marshy area about 8 miles (13 km) northeast of Doncaster on the south bank of the River Don, though this location has been disputed. It was a decisive victory for Gwynedd and the Mercians: Edwin was killed and his army defeated, leading to the temporary collapse of Northumbria.

Battle of Heavenfield.headline: Bitka pri Heavenfieldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Heavenfieldu je potekala leta 633 ali 634 med northumbrijsko vojsko pod Oswaldom Bernicijskim in valižansko vojsko pod Cadwallonom ap Cadfanom iz Gwynedda. Northumbrijci so odločilno zmagali. Annales Cambriae (Valižanski anali) bitko beležijo kot Bellum Cantscaul leta 631. Beda jo je imenoval bitka pri Deniseburni blizu Hefenfeltha.

source.title: Battle of Heavenfield
paragraphs: The Battle of Heavenfield was fought in 633 or 634 between a Northumbrian army under Oswald of Bernicia and a Welsh army under Cadwallon ap Cadfan of Gwynedd. The battle resulted in a decisive Northumbrian victory. The Annales Cambriae (Annals of Wales) record the battle as Bellum Cantscaul in 631. Bede referred to it as the Battle of Deniseburna near Hefenfelth.

Battle of Hedgeley Moor.headline: Bitka pri Hedgeley Mooru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hedgeley Mooru 25. aprila 1464 je potekala v vojni rož. Pri Hedgeley Mooru severno od vasi Glanton in Powburn v Northumberlandu sta se spopadli yorška vojska pod vodstvom Johna Nevilla, lorda Montaguja, in lancastrska vojska pod vodstvom Henryja Beauforta, vojvode Somerseta. Bitka se je končala z zmago Yorkov.

source.title: Battle of Hedgeley Moor
paragraphs: The Battle of Hedgeley Moor, 25 April 1464, took place during the Wars of the Roses. It was fought at Hedgeley Moor, north of the villages of Glanton and Powburn in Northumberland, between a Yorkist army led by John Neville, Lord Montagu and a Lancastrian army led by Henry Beaufort, Duke of Somerset. The battle ended in a Yorkist victory.

Battle of Hexham.headline: Bitka pri Hexhamu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hexhamu 15. maja 1464 je pomenila konec pomembnejšega lancastrskega odpora na severu Anglije v zgodnjem delu vladavine Edvarda IV.

Bitka je potekala blizu mesta Hexham v Northumberlandu. John Neville, poznejši 1. markiz Montagu, je s skromno vojsko 3000–4000 mož pognal v beg uporne lancastrovce. Večino uporniških voditeljev so ujeli in usmrtili, med njimi Henryja Beauforta, vojvodo Somerseta, in lorda Hungerforda. Henrik VI. pa je bil na varnem daleč stran (pred tem so ga v bojih že trikrat ujeli) in je pobegnil na sever.

Ker uporniki niso imeli več vodstva, je v njihovih rokah ostalo le nekaj gradov. Ko so ti pozneje istega leta padli, Edvarda IV. ni nihče resneje ogrožal, dokler grof Warwick leta 1469 ni prestopil z yorške na lancastrsko stran.

source.title: Battle of Hexham
paragraphs: The Battle of Hexham, 15 May 1464, marked the end of significant Lancastrian resistance in the north of England during the early part of the reign of Edward IV.

The battle was fought near the town of Hexham in Northumberland. John Neville, later to be 1st Marquess of Montagu, led a modest force of 3,000-4,000 men, and routed the rebel Lancastrians. Most of the rebel leaders were captured and executed, including Henry Beaufort, Duke of Somerset, and Lord Hungerford. Henry VI, however, was kept safely away (having been captured in battle three times earlier), and escaped to the north.

With their leadership gone, only a few castles remained in rebel hands. After these fell later in the year, Edward IV was not seriously challenged until the Earl of Warwick changed his allegiance from the Yorkist to the Lancastrian cause in 1469.

Battle of Ibera.headline: Bitka pri Iberi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Iberi, znana tudi kot bitka pri Dertosi, je potekala spomladi 215 pr. n. št. na južnem bregu reke Ebro blizu mesta Ibera in je bila del druge punske vojne. Rimska vojska pod poveljstvom bratov Gneja in Publija Scipiona je premagala podobno veliko kartažansko vojsko pod Hasdrubalom Barko. Rimljani pod Gnejem Scipionom so konec leta 218 pr. n. št. vdrli na Iberski polotok in si po zmagi v bitki pri Cissi ustvarili oporišče. To oporišče na severovzhodni iberski obali med Ebrom in Pireneji je zapiralo pot vsem okrepitvam z Iberskega polotoka za vojsko Hanibala, ki je v začetku tistega leta z Iberskega polotoka vdrl v Italijo. Hasdrubal je Rimljane skušal pregnati leta 217 pr. n. št., a se je to končalo s porazom, ko je bil kartažanski pomorski oddelek uničen v bitki pri reki Ebro.

source.title: Battle of Ibera
paragraphs: The Battle of Ibera, also known as the Battle of Dertosa, was fought in the spring of 215 BC on the south bank of the Ebro River near the town of Ibera and was part of the Second Punic War. A Roman army, under the command of the brothers Gnaeus and Publius Scipio, defeated a similarly sized Carthaginian army under Hasdrubal Barca. The Romans, under Gnaeus Scipio, had invaded Iberia in late 218 BC and established a foothold after winning the Battle of Cissa. This lodgement, on the north-east Iberian coast, between the Ebro and the Pyrenees, blocked the route of any reinforcements from Iberia for the army of Hannibal, who had invaded Italy from Iberia earlier in the year. Hasdrubal attempted to evict the Romans in 217 BC, but this ended in defeat when the Carthaginian naval contingent was mauled at the Battle of Ebro River.

Battle of Ilerda.headline: Bitka pri Ilerdi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ilerdi je potekala junija 49 pr. n. št. med silami Julija Cezarja in hispansko vojsko Pompeja Velikega, ki sta jo vodila njegova legata Lucij Afranij in Mark Petrej. V nasprotju s številnimi drugimi bitkami državljanske vojne je šlo bolj za manevrski pohod kot za prave boje. Cezarju je omogočil, da je odpravil nevarnost Pompejevih sil v Hispaniji in se s samim Pompejem spopadel v Grčiji v bitki pri Farzalu (48 pr. n. št.).

source.title: Battle of Ilerda
paragraphs: The Battle of Ilerda took place in June 49 BC between the forces of Julius Caesar and the Hispanian army of Pompey Magnus, led by his legates Lucius Afranius and Marcus Petreius. Unlike many of the other battles of the civil war, this was more a campaign of manoeuvre than actual fighting. It allowed Caesar to eliminate the threat of Pompey's forces in Hispania and face Pompey himself in Greece at the Battle of Pharsalus (48 BC).

Battle of Ilipa.headline: Bitka pri Ilipi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ilipi je bila spopad leta 206 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni, ki ga mnogi štejejo za najsijajnejšo zmago v vojaški karieri Scipiona Afriškega. Morda je potekala na ravnini vzhodno od kraja Alcalá del Río pri Sevilli v Španiji, blizu vasi Esquivel, kjer je bil kartažanski tabor.

Čeprav se morda ne zdi tako izvirna kot Hanibalova taktika pri Kanah, sta Scipionov manever pred bitko in njegova obrnjena formacija »Kane« vrhunec njegove taktične spretnosti: z njima je dokončno strl kartažanski nadzor in vir moči na Iberskem polotoku ter tako preprečil vsak nadaljnji kopenski vdor v Italijo in rodbini Barka odrezal bogato zaledje srebra in ljudi.

source.title: Battle of Ilipa
paragraphs: The Battle of Ilipa was an engagement considered by many as Scipio Africanus's most brilliant victory in his military career during the Second Punic War in 206 BC. It may have taken place on a plain east of Alcalá del Río, Seville, Spain, near the village of Esquivel, the site of the Carthaginian camp.

Though it may not seem to be as original as Hannibal's tactic at Cannae, Scipio's pre-battle maneuver and his reverse Cannae formation stands as the acme of his tactical ability, in which he permanently broke the Carthaginian grip and source of power in Iberia, thus denying any further land invasion into Italy and cutting off a rich base for the Barca dynasty both in silver and manpower.

Battle of Jarama.headline: Bitka pri Jarami
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jarami (6.–27. februarja 1937) je bila poskus nacionalistov generala Francisca Franca, da bi v španski državljanski vojni pregnali republikance z njihovih položajev ob reki Jarama tik vzhodno od Madrida. Elitni španski legionarji in maroški regulares iz Afriške armade so potisnili nazaj republikansko armado centra, vključno z mednarodnimi brigadami, a po več dneh hudih bojev preboja niso dosegli. Tudi republikanski protinapadi na izgubljenem ozemlju so spodleteli, obe strani pa sta utrpeli hude izgube.

source.title: Battle of Jarama
paragraphs: The Battle of Jarama (6–27 February 1937) was an attempt by General Francisco Franco's Nationalists to dislodge the Republican lines along the river Jarama, just east of Madrid, during the Spanish Civil War. Elite Spanish Legionnaires and Moroccan Regulares from the Army of Africa forced back the Republican Army of the Centre, including the International Brigades, but after days of fierce fighting no breakthrough was achieved. Republican counterattacks along the captured ground likewise failed, resulting in heavy casualties to both sides.

Battle of Killiecrankie.headline: Bitka pri Killiecrankieju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Killiecrankieju je potekala 27. julija 1689 med jakobitskim uporom leta 1689. Jakobitske sile pod vodstvom Ewana Camerona iz Lochiela in vikonta Dundeeja so premagale vojsko škotske vlade pod poveljstvom generalporočnika Hugha Mackaya. Jakob VII. je decembra 1688 odšel v izgnanstvo, potem ko ga je na Škotskem odstavila slavna revolucija. Marca 1689 je začel viljemovsko vojno na Irskem, hkrati pa je izbruhnil upor pod vodstvom Dundeeja, pred tem njegovega vojaškega poveljnika na Škotskem.

Čeprav so bili jakobiti v manjšini in jim je primanjkovalo zalog, so njihovi poveljniki upali, da jim bo odločilna zmaga prinesla širšo podporo. Zmago so sicer dosegli, a je njihova vojska utrpela hude izgube, Dundee pa je padel v zadnjih trenutkih bitke. Jakobiti zato uspeha niso mogli izkoristiti.

source.title: Battle of Killiecrankie
paragraphs: The Battle of Killiecrankie was fought on 27 July 1689 during the Jacobite rising of 1689. A Jacobite force led by Ewan Cameron of Lochiel and Viscount Dundee defeated a Scottish government army commanded by Lieutenant-general Hugh Mackay. James VII went into exile in December 1688 after being deposed by the Glorious Revolution in Scotland. In March 1689, he began the Williamite War in Ireland, with a simultaneous revolt led by Dundee, previously his military commander in Scotland.

Despite being outnumbered and short of supplies, the Jacobite commanders hoped a decisive victory would bring them wider support. Although this was achieved, their army suffered heavy casualties, and Dundee was killed in the final moments. As a result, the Jacobites were unable to capitalise on their success.

Battle of La Higueruela.headline: Bitka pri La Higueruela
paragraphs: Bitka pri La Higueruela (dobesedno »bitka pri drobni figi«) je potekala 1. julija 1431 v rodovitni dolini (vega) reke Genil blizu Granade med silami kastiljskega kralja Ivana II. pod vodstvom Álvara de Lune in enotami, zvestimi Mohamedu IX., nasridskemu sultanu Granade. Bitka je bila skromna zmaga kastiljskih sil, saj niso pridobile ozemlja in niso zavzele Granade. Po bitki je kastiljski kralj Ivan II. za granadskega sultana postavil Jusufa IV., vnuka Mohameda VI.
Bitko prikazuje slavna serija fresk Fabrizia Castella, Orazia Cambiasija in Lazzara Tavaroneja v Galeriji bitk v kraljevem samostanu San Lorenzo de El Escorial.

source.title: Battle of La Higueruela
paragraphs: The Battle of La Higueruela (lit. 'Battle at the little fig tree') was fought in the vega of the river Genil near Granada on 1 July 1431 between the forces of John II of Castile, led by Álvaro de Luna, and troops loyal to Muhammed IX, Nasrid Sultan of Granada. The battle was a modest victory for the forces of Castile, with no territorial gain and failing to take Granada. Following this battle, John II of Castile installed Yusuf IV, grandson of Muhammed VI, as Sultan of Granada.

The battle is depicted in a famous series of fresco paintings by Fabrizio Castello, Orazio Cambiasi and Lazzaro Tavarone in the Gallery of Battles at the Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial.

Battle of Lagos.headline: Bitka pri Lagosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lagosu je bila dvodnevni spopad leta 1759 v sedemletni vojni med britanskim ladjevjem pod poveljstvom Edwarda Boscawena in francoskim ladjevjem pod Jeanom-Françoisom de La Clue-Sabranom. Ladjevji sta se 18. avgusta spopadli jugozahodno od Cádiškega zaliva, 19. avgusta pa vzhodno od majhnega portugalskega pristanišča Lagos, po katerem je bitka dobila ime.

source.title: Battle of Lagos
paragraphs: The Battle of Lagos took place between a British fleet commanded by Edward Boscawen and a French fleet under Jean-François de La Clue-Sabran over two days in 1759 during the Seven Years' War. They fought south west of the Gulf of Cádiz on 18 August and to the east of the small Portuguese port of Lagos, after which the battle is named, on 19 August.

Battle of Largs.headline: Bitka pri Largsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Largsu (2. oktobra 1263) je bila bitka med kraljevinama Norveško in Škotsko v zalivu Firth of Clyde blizu Largsa na Škotskem. Spopad je bil del norveške odprave proti Škotski leta 1263, s katero je norveški kralj Haakon Haakonsson skušal znova uveljaviti norveško suverenost nad zahodno obalo Škotske. Škoti so zmagali po zaslugi premetene trojne strategije mladega škotskega kralja Aleksandra III.: počasna diplomacija je pohod potisnila v mesece slabega vremena, silovita nevihta je opustošila norveško ladjevje in mu odnesla veliko ladij in zalog, sile na škotski obali pa so postale ranljive za napad, ki je Norvežane prisilil v nagel umik. Ta je končal njihovo 500-letno zgodovino vpadov, Škotska pa je lahko svoje vire usmerila v graditev države.

source.title: Battle of Largs
paragraphs: The Battle of Largs (2 October 1263) was a battle between the kingdoms of Norway and Scotland, on the Firth of Clyde near Largs, Scotland. The conflict formed part of the Norwegian expedition against Scotland in 1263, in which Haakon Haakonsson, King of Norway attempted to reassert Norwegian sovereignty over the western seaboard of Scotland. Victory was achieved by the Scots with a crafty three-tiered strategy on the part of the young Scottish king, Alexander III: plodding diplomacy forced the campaign to bad weather months and a ferocious storm ravaged the Norwegian fleet, stripping it of many vessels and supplies and making the forces on the Scottish coast vulnerable to an attack that forced the Norwegians into a hasty retreat that was to end their 500-year history of invasion, and leaving Scotland to consolidate its resources into building the nation.

Bitka pri Las Navas de Tolosa, v islamski zgodovini znana kot bitka pri Al Ukabu (arabsko: معركة العقاب), je potekala 16. julija 1212 in je bila pomembna prelomnica rekonkviste in zgodovine srednjeveške Španije. Krščanske sile je vodil kastiljski kralj Alfonz VIII., pridružila pa sta se mu njegova tekmeca, navarski kralj Sančo VII. in aragonski kralj Peter II. Muslimansko vojsko je vodil kalif al Nasir (v španskih kronikah Miramamolín), vladar Almohadskega kalifata, ki je obsegal južno polovico Iberskega polotoka in Maroko.
Navas de Tolosa (imenovan tudi Las Navas) je kraj in zaselek na jugu Španije v občini La Carolina v provinci Jaén, na vzhodu pogorja Sierra Morena, 15 kilometrov od meje s provinco Ciudad Real.
notes: The miles conversion (9.3 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa
paragraphs: The Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa, known in Islamic history as the Battle of Al-Uqab (Arabic: معركة العقاب), took place on 16 July 1212 and was an important turning point in the Reconquista and the history of medieval Spain. The Christian forces were led by King Alfonso VIII of Castile, joined by his rivals, Kings Sancho VII of Navarre and Peter II of Aragon. The Muslim army was led by caliph al-Nasir (Miramamolín in the Spanish chronicles), ruler of the Almohad Caliphate, which included the southern half of the Iberian Peninsula and Morocco.

Navas de Tolosa (also called Las Navas) is a town and hamlet in southern Spain, in the municipality of La Carolina, in the province of Jaén, in the eastern part of the Sierra Morena region, 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) from the border with the province of Ciudad Real.

Battle of Lewes.headline: Bitka pri Lewesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lewesu je bila ena od dveh glavnih bitk spopada, znanega kot druga baronska vojna. Potekala je 14. maja 1264 pri Lewesu v Sussexu. Pomenila je vrhunec kariere Simona de Montforta, 6. grofa Leicestra, in iz njega naredila »nekronanega angleškega kralja«. Sile Henrika III. so zapustile varno zavetje gradu Lewes in priorata sv. Pankracija, da bi se z baroni spopadle v bitki, in bile sprva uspešne, saj je Henrikov sin princ Edvard s konjeniškim napadom pognal v beg del baronske vojske. Edvard pa je ubežnike zasledoval daleč z bojišča in Henrikove može pustil nezaščitene. Henrik je moral sprožiti pehotni napad na grič Offham Hill, kjer so ga premagali možje baronov, ki so branili vrh. Rojalisti so pobegnili nazaj v grad in priorat, kralj pa je moral podpisati lewesko poravnavo (Mise of Lewes) in de Montfortu prepustiti velik del svoje oblasti.

source.title: Battle of Lewes
paragraphs: The Battle of Lewes was one of two main battles of the conflict known as the Second Barons' War. It took place at Lewes in Sussex, on 14 May 1264. It marked the high point of the career of Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester, and made him the "uncrowned King of England". Henry III's forces left the safety of Lewes Castle and St. Pancras Priory to engage the barons in battle and were initially successful, with Henry's son Prince Edward routing part of the baronial army with a cavalry charge. However, Edward pursued his quarry off the battlefield and left Henry's men exposed. Henry was forced to launch an infantry attack up Offham Hill where he was defeated by the barons' men defending the summit. The royalists fled back to the castle and priory and the King was forced to sign the Mise of Lewes, ceding many of his powers to de Montfort.

Battle of Lincoln (1141).headline: Bitka pri Lincolnu (1141)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lincolnu ali prva bitka pri Lincolnu je potekala 2. februarja 1141 v Lincolnu v Angliji med angleškim kraljem Štefanom in silami, zvestimi cesarici Matildi. Štefana so v bitki ujeli, zaprli in dejansko odstavili, Matilda pa je za kratek čas vladala.

source.title: Battle of Lincoln (1141)
paragraphs: The Battle of Lincoln, or the First Battle of Lincoln, occurred on 2 February 1141 in Lincoln, England between King Stephen of England and forces loyal to Empress Matilda. Stephen was captured during the battle, imprisoned, and effectively deposed while Matilda ruled for a short time.

Battle of Lincoln (1217).headline: Bitka pri Lincolnu (1217)
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Lincolnu je potekala v soboto, 20. maja 1217, pri gradu Lincoln med prvo baronsko vojno, med silami poznejšega francoskega kralja Ludvika VIII. in silami angleškega kralja Henrika III. Ludvikove sile je napadla reševalna vojska pod poveljstvom Williama Marshala, 1. grofa Pembroka. Tomaž, grof Perchea, ki je poveljeval francoskim enotam, je padel, Ludvik pa je bil pregnan iz svojega oporišča na jugovzhodu Anglije. Plenjenje, ki je sledilo, je znano kot »lincolnski sejem«. Meščani Lincolna so bili zvesti Ludviku, zato so Henrikove sile mesto oplenile.

source.title: Battle of Lincoln (1217)
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Lincoln occurred at Lincoln Castle on Saturday 20 May 1217, during the First Barons' War, between the forces of the future Louis VIII of France and those of King Henry III of England. Louis's forces were attacked by a relief force under the command of William Marshal, 1st Earl of Pembroke. Thomas, Count of Perche, commanding the French troops, was killed and Louis was expelled from his base in the southeast of England. The looting that took place afterwards is known as the "Lincoln Fair". The citizens of Lincoln were loyal to Louis so Henry's forces sacked the city.
Berga je glavno mesto comarce (okraja) Berguedà v provinci Barcelona v Kataloniji v Španiji. Meji na občine Cercs, Olvan, Avià, Capolat in Castellar del Riu.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is a state, but its link points to the article on the modern town; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Berga
paragraphs: Berga (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈbeɾɣə]) is the capital of the comarca (county) of Berguedà, in the province of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It is bordered by the municipalities of Cercs, Olvan, Avià, Capolat and Castellar del Riu.

Bernicia.headline: Bernicija
paragraphs: Bernicija (staroangleško: Bernica rice, Beornica rice) je bila anglosaško kraljestvo, ki so ga v 6. stoletju ustanovili anglski naseljenci na območju današnje jugovzhodne Škotske in severovzhodne Anglije.

Anglsko ozemlje Bernicije je približno ustrezalo današnjim angleškim grofijam Northumberland, Tyne and Wear in Durham ter škotskima grofijama Berwickshire in East Lothian in je segalo od reke Forth do reke Tees. V začetku 7. stoletja se je Bernicija združila z južno sosedo Deiro v kraljestvo Northumbrija, njene meje pa so se nato precej razširile.

source.title: Bernicia
paragraphs: Bernicia (Old English: Bernica rice, Beornica rice) was an Anglo-Saxon kingdom established by Anglian settlers of the 6th century in what is now southeastern Scotland and North East England.

The Anglian territory of Bernicia was approximately equivalent to the modern English counties of Northumberland, Tyne and Wear, and Durham, as well as the Scottish counties of Berwickshire and East Lothian, stretching from the Forth to the Tees. In the early 7th century, it merged with its southern neighbour, Deira, to form the kingdom of Northumbria, and its borders subsequently expanded considerably.

Brycheiniog.headline: Brycheiniog
paragraphs: Brycheiniog je bil neodvisno kraljestvo v južnem Walesu v zgodnjem srednjem veku. Pogosto je bil tamponska država med Anglijo na vzhodu in južnovaližanskim kraljestvom Deheubarth na zahodu. Normani so ga med letoma 1088 in 1095 osvojili in pomirili, a je ohranil valižanski značaj. Preoblikovali so ga v gospostvo Brecknock, pozneje pa je tvoril južni in večji del zgodovinske grofije Brecknockshire. Južno od njega je ležalo kraljestvo Morgannwg.

Glavna dediščina kraljestva Brycheiniog je etimološka in geografska. Ime se ohranja v Bannau Brycheiniog, valižanskem imenu gorovja Brecon Beacons, od leta 2023 pa tudi v imenu narodnega parka v tem gorovju. Iz njega izhajata tudi poangleščeni imeni Brecknockshire (v valižanščini ohranjeno kot Sir Frycheiniog, »grofija Brycheiniog«) in Brecon (v valižanščini tudi Aberhonddu).

source.title: Brycheiniog
paragraphs: Brycheiniog was an independent kingdom in South Wales in the Early Middle Ages. It often acted as a buffer state between England to the east and the south Welsh kingdom of Deheubarth to the west. It was conquered and pacified by the Normans between 1088 and 1095, though it remained Welsh in character. It was transformed into the Lordship of Brecknock and later formed the southern and larger part of the historic county of Brecknockshire. To its south was the Kingdom of Morgannwg.

The main legacy of the kingdom of Brycheiniog is etymological and geographical. It is used in Bannau Brycheiniog, the Welsh name for the Brecon Beacons range and, since 2023, in name used for the range's national park. Its name is also the origin to the anglicised names Brecknockshire (retained in Welsh as Sir Frycheiniog, 'the shire of Brycheiniog'), and Brecon (otherwise known as Aberhonddu in Welsh).

Angleška republika (Commonwealth of England), ki se je leta 1653 razširila v Republiko Anglijo, Škotsko in Irsko, je bila politična ureditev v obdobju 1649–1660, ko je bilo Kraljestvo Anglija po koncu druge angleške državljanske vojne ter sojenju in usmrtitvi Karla I. razpuščeno in spremenjeno v republiko. Obstoj republike je razglasil zakon »An Act declaring England to be a Commonwealth« (Zakon o razglasitvi Anglije za republiko), ki ga je okrnjeni parlament (Rump Parliament) sprejel 19. maja 1649. Oblast v zgodnji republiki sta imela predvsem parlament in državni svet. V tem času so se nadaljevali boji med parlamentarnimi silami in njihovimi nasprotniki, zlasti na Irskem in Škotskem: Cromwellova osvojitev Irske in angleško-škotska vojna v letih 1650–1652.

source.title: Commonwealth of England
paragraphs: The Commonwealth of England, enlarged in 1653 as the Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland, was the political structure during the period from 1649 to 1660 when the Kingdom of England was dissolved into a republic after the end of the Second English Civil War and the trial and execution of Charles I. The republic's existence was declared through "An Act declaring England to be a Commonwealth", adopted by the Rump Parliament on 19 May 1649. Power in the early Commonwealth was vested primarily in the Parliament and a Council of State. During the period, fighting continued, particularly in Ireland and Scotland, between the parliamentary forces and those opposed to them, in the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland and the Anglo-Scottish war of 1650–1652.

Irska konfederacija, imenovana tudi Irska katoliška konfederacija, je bila obdobje irske katoliške samouprave med letoma 1642 in 1652, med enajstletno vojno. Ustanovili so jo katoliški aristokrati, zemljiško plemstvo, duhovščina in vojaški voditelji po irskem uporu leta 1641; konfederati so s sedežem v Kilkennyju nadzorovali do dve tretjini Irske, zato jo včasih imenujejo tudi konfederacija iz Kilkennyja.

source.title: Confederate Ireland
paragraphs: Confederate Ireland, also referred to as the Irish Catholic Confederation, was a period of Irish Catholic self-government between 1642 and 1652, during the Eleven Years' War. Formed by Catholic aristocrats, landed gentry, clergy and military leaders after the Irish Rebellion of 1641, the Confederates controlled up to two-thirds of Ireland from their base in Kilkenny; hence it is sometimes called the Confederation of Kilkenny.

Grofija Aragonija (aragonsko: Condato d'Aragón) ali grofija Jaca (aragonsko: Condato de Chaca) je bila majhna frankovska mejna grofija v osrednji pirenejski dolini reke Aragón, ki je obsegala Ansó, Echo in Canfranc s središčem v mestecu Jaca (latinsko Iacca, aragonsko Chaca), na območju današnje Španije. Ustanovili so jo Karolingi konec 8. ali v začetku 9. stoletja, a je kmalu prišla pod vpliv navarskega kraljestva, ki mu je bila leta 922 priključena. Pozneje je postala jedro aragonskega kraljestva v 11. stoletju.

source.title: County of Aragon
paragraphs: The County of Aragon (Aragonese: Condato d'Aragón) or County of Jaca (Aragonese: Condato de Chaca) was a small Frankish marcher county in the central Pyrenean valley of the Aragon river, comprising Ansó, Echo, and Canfranc and centered on the small town of Jaca (Iacca in Latin and Chaca in Aragonese), an area now part of Spain. It was created by the Carolingians late in the 8th or early in the 9th century, but soon fell into the orbit of the Kingdom of Navarre, into which it was absorbed in 922. It would later form the core of the 11th century Kingdom of Aragon.

County of Besalú.headline: Grofija Besalú
paragraphs: Grofija Besalú (katalonsko: Comtat de Besalú; latinsko: Comitatus Bisuldunensis) je bila ena od srednjeveških katalonskih grofij brez dostopa do morja blizu sredozemske obale. Približno se je ujemala z današnjo comarco Garrotxa, občasno pa je segala vse do Corbièresa v departmaju Aude, danes v Franciji. Glavni kraj je bila vas Besalú. Večino zgodovine je bila priključena kateri od drugih, močnejših grofij, stoletje pa je bila neodvisna, preden so jo dokončno in nepreklicno priključili barcelonski grofiji.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Besalú
paragraphs: The County of Besalú (Catalan: Comtat de Besalú, IPA: [kumˈtad də βəzəˈlu]; Latin: Comitatus Bisuldunensis) was one of the landlocked medieval Catalan counties near the Mediterranean coastline. It was roughly coterminous with the modern comarca of Garrotxa and at various times extended as far north as Corbières, Aude, now in France. Its capital was the village of Besalú. Throughout most of its history it was attached to one of the other more powerful counties, but it experienced a century of independence before it was finally and irrevocably annexed to the County of Barcelona.

Grofija Empúries (katalonsko: Comtat d'Empúries), znana tudi kot grofija Ampurias (špansko: Condado de Ampurias), je bila srednjeveška grofija s središčem v mestu Empúries, ki je obsegala katalonsko pokrajino Peralada. Ustreza zgodovinski comarci Empordà.

Ko so Franki leta 785 osvojili te pokrajine, sta Empúries in Peralada prišli pod oblast grofije Girona. Okoli leta 813 je Empúries skupaj s Peralado postala samostojna grofija pod Ermenguerjem. Ta in drugi zgodnji grofje so bili verjetno vizigotskega rodu. Leta 817 so Empúries združili z grofijo Roussillon, zveza pa je trajala do leta 989. Eden od grofov Empúriesa v 9. stoletju je zbral dovolj močno ladjevje, da je osvojil Balearske otoke, a le za kratek čas. Od leta 835 do 844 je Empúriesu in Peraladi vladal Sunyer I., Roussillonu in Vallespirju pa Alarik I.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Empúries
paragraphs: The County of Empúries (Catalan: Comtat d'Empúries, IPA: [kumˈtad dəmˈpuɾiəs]), also known as the County of Ampurias (Spanish: Condado de Ampurias), was a medieval county centred on the town of Empúries and enclosing the Catalan region of Peralada. It corresponds to the historic comarca of Empordà.

After the Franks conquered the regions in 785, Empúries and Peralada came under the authority of the County of Girona. Around 813, Empúries, with Peralada, became a separate county under Ermenguer. He and the other early counts were probably of Visigothic origin. In 817, Empúries was merged with the County of Roussillon, a union which lasted until 989. One of the ninth-century counts of Empúries assembled a fleet powerful enough to conquer the Balearic Islands, but only for a brief time. From 835 to 844, Sunyer I ruled Empúries and Peralada while Alaric I ruled Roussillon and Vallespir.

County of Osona.headline: Grofija Osona
paragraphs: Grofija Osona ali Ausona (katalonsko: Comtat d'Osona; latinsko: Comitatus Ausonae) je bila ena od katalonskih grofij Hispanske marke v zgodnjem in visokem srednjem veku. Središče je imela v glavnem mestu Vic (Vicus) in pripadajoči škofiji, katere ozemlje je približno ustrezalo današnji comarci Osona.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Osona
paragraphs: The County of Osona, also Ausona (Catalan: Comtat d'Osona, IPA: [kumˈtad duˈzonə]; Latin: Comitatus Ausonae), was one of the Catalan counties of the Marca Hispanica in the Early and High Middle Ages. It was based around the capital city of Vic (Vicus) and the corresponding diocese, whose territory was roughly the current comarca of Osona.

County of Pallars.headline: Grofija Pallars
paragraphs: Grofija Pallars ali Pallás (katalonsko: Comtat de Pallars; latinsko: Comitatus Pallariensis) je bila v 9. in 10. stoletju dejansko neodvisna majhna država, formalno v Karolinškem cesarstvu in nato v Zahodni Frankovski, morda ena od katalonskih grofij, ki je bila sprva v 9. stoletju del Hispanske marke. Obsegala je zgornjo dolino reke Noguera Pallaresa od grebena Pirenejev do vasi Tremp, z dolinami Vall d'Àneu, Vall de Cardós in Vall Ferrera, desnim bregom reke Noguera Ribagorçana in dolino reke Flamicell. Približno je ustrezala zgodovinski katalonski pokrajini Pallars. Glavno mesto je bil Sort.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Pallars
paragraphs: The County of Pallars or Pallás (Catalan: Comtat de Pallars, IPA: [kumˈtad də pəˈʎas]; Latin: Comitatus Pallariensis) was a de facto independent petty state, nominally within the Carolingian Empire and then West Francia during the ninth and tenth centuries, perhaps one of the Catalan counties, originally part of the Marca Hispanica in the ninth century. It was coterminous with the upper Noguera Pallaresa valley from the crest of the Pyrenees to the village of Tremp, comprising the Vall d'Àneu, Vall de Cardós, Vall Ferrera, the right bank of the Noguera Ribagorçana, and the valley of the Flamicell. It roughly corresponded with the historic region of Catalonia called Pallars. Its chief city was Sort.

County of Ribagorza.headline: Grofija Ribagorza
paragraphs: Grofija Ribagorza ali Ribagorça (aragonsko: Condato de Ribagorza; katalonsko: Comtat de Ribagorça; latinsko: Comitatus Ripacurtiae) je bila srednjeveška grofija na južni strani Pirenejev, ki je obsegala severovzhod današnje Aragonije in del severozahoda današnje Katalonije, obe v Španiji. Sprva jo je samostojno ustanovila krajevna dinastija, pozneje pa je bila vključena v navarsko kraljestvo in nato v Aragonsko krono. Tesno zgodovinsko je bila povezana s sosednjima grofijama Sobrarbe (na zahodu) in Pallars (na vzhodu). Njeno ozemlje so sestavljale doline rek Ésera, Isábena in Noguera Ribagorzana. Sedež grofov je bil v Benabarreju, med drugimi pomembnimi kraji so Benasque, Graus in Pont de Suert. Zahodni del grofije danes približno ustreza aragonski comarci Ribagorza s središčem v Grausu, vzhodni pa katalonski comarci Alta Ribagorça.

source.title: County of Ribagorza
paragraphs: The County of Ribagorza or Ribagorça (Aragonese: Condato de Ribagorza; Catalan: Comtat de Ribagorça; Latin: Comitatus Ripacurtiae) was a medieval county on the southern side of the Pyrenees, including the northeast of modern Aragón and part of the northwest of modern Catalonia, both in Spain. It was originally the independent creation of a local dynasty, later absorbed into the Kingdom of Navarre and then into the Crown of Aragon. It had a strong historical connection with the neighboring counties of Sobrarbe (to the west) and Pallars (to the east). Its territory consisted of the valleys of the rivers Ésera, Isábena, and Noguera Ribagorzana. The seat of its counts was at Benabarre. Other notable towns include Benasque, Graus and Pont de Suert. Today the western portion of the county roughly corresponds to the Aragonese comarca of Ribagorza, with its administrative centre in Graus; the eastern portion roughly corresponds to the Catalan comarca of Alta Ribagorça.
Grofija Urgell (katalonsko: Comtat d'Urgell; latinsko: Comitatus Urgellensis) je ena od zgodovinskih katalonskih grofij, ki je mejila na grofiji Pallars in Cerdanya.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Urgell
paragraphs: The County of Urgell (Catalan: Comtat d'Urgell, IPA: [komˈtad duɾˈdʒeʎ]; Latin: Comitatus Urgellensis) is one of the historical Catalan counties, bordering on the counties of Pallars and Cerdanya.

Dál Riata.headline: Dál Riata
paragraphs: Dál Riata ali Dál Riada (tudi Dalriada) je bila gelsko kraljestvo na zahodni obali Škotske in severovzhodu Irske, na obeh straneh Severnega preliva. Na vrhuncu v 6. in 7. stoletju je obsegala današnji Argyll (»obala Gelov«) na Škotskem in del grofije Antrim na Severnem Irskem. Po obdobju širitve se je Dál Riata sčasoma povezala z gelskim kraljestvom Alba.

source.title: Dál Riata
paragraphs: Dál Riata or Dál Riada (also Dalriada) was a Gaelic kingdom that encompassed the western seaboard of Scotland and northeastern Ireland, on each side of the North Channel. At its height in the 6th and 7th centuries, it covered what is now Argyll ("Coast of the Gaels") in Scotland and part of County Antrim in Northern Ireland. After a period of expansion, Dál Riata eventually became associated with the Gaelic Kingdom of Alba.

Danish attacks on Norman England.headline: Danski napadi na normansko Anglijo
paragraphs: Danci so normansko Anglijo napadli dvakrat. Prvič so v letih 1069–1070 vdrli v zavezništvu z različnimi angleškimi uporniki in zavzeli najprej York in nato Ely, nazadnje pa so sprejeli podkupnino in zapustili državo. Drugič je šlo za obsežen roparski pohod leta 1075 v podporo uporu grofov, med katerim so opustošili obalo Lincolnshira in York. Tretji napad je bil načrtovan leta 1085: zbrali so veliko invazijsko ladjevje danskih, flamskih in norveških ladij, ki pa ni nikoli izplulo. Vse tri napade je spodbudila zahteva po angleškem prestolu, ki jo je prvi uveljavljal danski kralj Sven II. (vladal 1047–1076), nečak Knuta Velikega, poznejši danski kralji pa so jo vzdrževali vse do 13. stoletja. Toda nobeden od obeh uresničenih napadov ni Svenove zahteve uveljavil niti Dancem ni prinesel ničesar razen nekaj plena.

source.title: Danish attacks on Norman England
paragraphs: There were two Danish attacks on Norman England. The first was an invasion in 1069–1070 conducted in alliance with various English rebels which succeeded in taking first York and then Ely before the Danes finally accepted a bribe to leave the country. The second was a large-scale raid in 1075, intended to support the Revolt of the Earls, in which the Lincolnshire coast and York were both ravaged. A third attack was planned in 1085, and a large invasion fleet composed of Danish, Flemish, and Norwegian vessels was assembled which never sailed. All three attacks were motivated by a claim on the English throne asserted originally by Cnut the Great's nephew Sweyn II, king of Denmark (r. 1047–1076), and maintained by later Danish kings until as late as the 13th century, but neither of the two realised attacks succeeded in making Sweyn's claim good, or indeed gained anything for the Danes apart from a certain amount of plunder.
Deira (starovaližansko/kumbrijsko: Deywr ali Deifr; staroangleško: Dere ali Dera rice) je bila območje v porimski Britaniji in pozneje anglsko kraljestvo.
notes: The English pronunciation guide is dropped.

source.title: Deira
paragraphs: Deira ( DY-rə, DAIR-ə; Old Welsh/Cumbric: Deywr or Deifr; Old English: Dere or Dera rice) was an area of Post-Roman Britain, and a later Anglian kingdom.

Danska - Norveška je bila večnarodna in večjezična realna unija od 16. do 19. stoletja, ki so jo sestavljali Kraljevina Danska, Kraljevina Norveška (s tedanjimi norveškimi čezmorskimi posestmi: Ferskimi otoki, Islandijo, Grenlandijo in drugimi), Vojvodina Schleswig in Vojvodina Holstein. Država je zahtevala suverenost tudi nad tremi zgodovinskimi ljudstvi: Frizijci, Guti in Vendi. Imela je več kolonij, in sicer Dansko Zlato obalo, Dansko Indijo (Nikobarske otoke, Serampore, Tharangambadi) in Dansko Zahodno Indijo.

Prebivalci države so bili predvsem Danci, Norvežani in Nemci, v norveških čezmorskih posestih pa tudi Ferci, Islandci in Inuiti, na severu Norveške samijska manjšina ter druga domorodna ljudstva. Glavna mesta Danske - Norveške so bila København, Christiania (Oslo), Altona, Bergen in Trondhjem, glavna uradna jezika sta bila danščina in nemščina, krajevno pa so govorili tudi norveško, islandsko, fersko, samijsko in grenlandsko.

source.title: Denmark–Norway
paragraphs: Denmark–Norway was a 16th-to-19th-century multi-national and multi-lingual real union consisting of the Kingdom of Denmark, the Kingdom of Norway (including the then Norwegian overseas possessions: the Faroe Islands, Iceland, Greenland, and other possessions), the Duchy of Schleswig, and the Duchy of Holstein. The state also claimed sovereignty over three historical peoples: Frisians, Gutes and Wends. Denmark–Norway had several colonies, namely the Danish Gold Coast, Danish India (the Nicobar Islands, Serampore, Tharangambadi), and the Danish West Indies.

The state's inhabitants were mainly Danes, Norwegians and Germans, and also included Faroese, Icelanders and Inuit in the Norwegian overseas possessions, a Sami minority in northern Norway, as well as other indigenous peoples. The main cities of Denmark–Norway were Copenhagen, Christiania (Oslo), Altona, Bergen and Trondhjem, and the primary official languages were Danish and German, but Norwegian, Icelandic, Faroese, Sami and Greenlandic were also spoken locally.

Vojvodina Gaskonja ali vojvodina Vaskonija je bila vojvodina na jugozahodu današnje Francije in severovzhodu Španije, na območju današnje pokrajine Gaskonja. Vojvodina, tedaj znana kot Vaskonija, je bila sprva frankovska marka, ustanovljena za obvladovanje Baskov. Doživela je različna obdobja, od zgodnjih let z izrazito baskovsko prvino prek personalne unije z Vojvodino Akvitanijo do poznejšega obdobja, ko je bila odvisno ozemlje angleških kraljev iz rodbine Plantagenet.

Gaskonja je bila približno 300 let, od leta 1152 do 1453, neprekinjeno pod angleško oblastjo. Francoski kralj Karel VII. je ozemlje znova osvojil kot zadnje dejanje stoletne vojne, Kraljevina Francija pa si je severni del ozemlja priključila leta 1453. Ustrezni del na Iberskem polotoku je postal Kraljestvo Navara.

source.title: Duchy of Gascony
paragraphs: The Duchy of Gascony or Duchy of Vasconia was a duchy located in present-day southwestern France and northeastern Spain, an area encompassing the modern region of Gascony. The Duchy of Gascony, then known as Vasconia, was originally a Frankish march formed to hold sway over the Basques. However, the duchy went through different periods, from its early years with its distinctively Basque element to the merger in personal union with the Duchy of Aquitaine to the later period as a dependency of the Plantagenet kings of England.

Gascony was under continuous English rule for approximately 300 years, from 1152 to 1453. Charles VII of France reconquered the territory as a final act of the Hundred Years' War and the northern part of the territory was annexed by the Kingdom of France in 1453. The corresponding portion within the Iberian Peninsula became the Kingdom of Navarre.

Dumnonija (starogrško: Δαμνόνιον, Damnónion, v pridevniški obliki), polatinjeno ime, je bila britonsko kraljestvo, ki je med 6. in 7. stoletjem n. št. obstajalo v porimski Britaniji, v zahodnejših delih današnje jugozahodne Anglije.

Predhodno predrimsko ozemlje Dumnonijcev je imelo središče na območju današnjega Devona, obsegalo pa je tudi današnji Cornwall in del Somerseta; njegova vzhodna meja se je sčasoma pomikala proti zahodu, ko se je postopoma širilo sosednje anglosaško kraljestvo Wessex. Včasih se pojavlja tudi zapis Damnonia, ki pa označuje tudi deželo Damnonijcev, pozneje del Kraljestva Strathclyde na jugu današnje Škotske.
Pojavlja se tudi oblika Domnonia. Ime kraljestva je jezikovno sorodno z imenom bretonske pokrajine Domnonée (bretonsko: Domnonea).

source.title: Dumnonia
paragraphs: Dumnonia (Ancient Greek: Δαμνόνιον, romanized: Damnónion, in the adjective form), a Latinised name, was a Brythonic kingdom that existed in Sub-Roman Britain between the 6th century CE and the 7th century CE in the more westerly parts of present-day South West England.

Its predecessor, the pre-Roman Dumnonii territory, was centred in the area of modern Devon, but also included modern Cornwall and part of Somerset; its eastern boundary was moved westward over time with the gradual expansion of the neighbouring Anglo-Saxon kingdom of Wessex. The spelling Damnonia is sometimes encountered, but that spelling is also used for the land of the Damnonii, later part of the Kingdom of Strathclyde, in present-day southern Scotland.
The form Domnonia also occurs. The name of the kingdom shares a linguistic relationship with the Breton region of Domnonée (Breton: Domnonea).

Dunoding.headline: Dunoding
paragraphs: Dunoding je bil zgodnje podkraljestvo v Kraljestvu Gwynedd na severozahodu Walesa, ki je obstajalo med 5. in 10. stoletjem. Po izročilu je dobil ime po Dunodu, ki je okoli leta 460 z območja pregnal irske naseljence; Dunod je bil sin Cunedde Wlediga, ustanovitelja Gwynedda. Ozemlje je kot podrejeno kraljestvo v Gwyneddu obstajalo, dokler okoli leta 925 ni izumrla rodbina vladarjev, ki so izhajali od Dunoda. Po koncu Dunodove rodbine so ga razdelili na kantrefa Eifionydd in Ardudwy ter ga v celoti priključili Gwyneddu. Ko je bilo kraljestvo Gwynedd leta 1283 poraženo in priključeno Angliji, sta kantrefa postala dela grofij Caernarfonshire oziroma Merionethshire. Danes je ozemlje del sodobne grofije Gwynedd.

source.title: Dunoding
paragraphs: Dunoding was an early sub-kingdom within the Kingdom of Gwynedd in north-west Wales which existed between the 5th and 10th centuries. According to tradition, it was named after Dunod, a son of the founding father of Gwynedd – Cunedda Wledig – who drove the Irish settlers from the area in c. 460. The territory existed as a subordinate realm within Gwynedd until the line of rulers descended from Dunod expired in c. 925. Following the end of the House of Dunod, it was split into the cantrefi of Eifionydd and Ardudwy and fully incorporated into Gwynedd. After the defeat of the kingdom of Gwynedd in 1283 and its annexation to England, the two cantrefi became parts of the counties of Caernarfonshire and Merionethshire, respectively. It is now part of the modern county of Gwynedd.

Earl of Desmond.headline: Grof Desmond
paragraphs: Grof Desmond (irsko: Iarla Dheasumhan, kar pomeni »grof južnega Munstra«) je plemiški naslov, ki ga je angleški monarh ustvaril v irskem plemstvu. Naslov je bil podeljen štirikrat. Prvič ga je leta 1329 dobil Maurice FitzGerald, 4. baron Desmond, hibernsko-normanski gospod na jugozahodu Irske, njegovi potomci pa so ga imeli do leta 1583, ko so se v desmondskih uporih uprli angleški kroni. Po dveh kratkotrajnih ponovnih podelitvah v začetku 17. stoletja ima naslov od leta 1628 rodbina Feilding iz Warwickshira v Angliji. Sedanji nosilec je Alexander Feilding, 12. grof Denbigh in 11. grof Desmond (4. podelitev). Grofija rodbine Fitzgerald je zgodovinsko obsegala vso današnjo grofijo Limerick ter velike dele grofij Cork, Kerry in Waterford. Mejila je na kraljestvi Desmond in Thomond ter na grofijo Ormond.
notes: The record is the earldom as a state; the article is about the title. "The early 1600s" is given as the beginning of the 17th century.

source.title: Earl of Desmond
paragraphs: Earl of Desmond (Irish: Iarla Dheasumhan meaning Earl of South Munster) is a title of nobility created by the English monarch in the peerage of Ireland. The title has been created four times. It was first awarded in 1329 to Maurice FitzGerald, 4th Baron Desmond, a Hiberno-Norman lord in Southwest Ireland, and it was held by his descendants until 1583 when they rose against the English crown in the Desmond Rebellions. Following two short-lived recreations of the title in the early 1600s, the title has been held since 1628 by the Feilding family of Warwickshire, England. The current holder is Alexander Feilding, 12th Earl of Denbigh and 11th Earl of Desmond (4th creation). The earldom held by the Fitzgerald family historically comprised what is now the entirety of County Limerick with large swathes of County Cork, County Kerry and County Waterford also being included. It bordered the Kingdom of Desmond, Kingdom of Thomond and the Earldom of Ormond

Habsburška Španija, znana tudi kot katoliška monarhija, je bila obdobje španske zgodovine in Španskega imperija od leta 1516 do 1700, ko so vladali kralji iz habsburške dinastije. Španski imperij je bil tedaj na vrhuncu moči in vpliva. Španija je imela številna ozemlja, med drugim celinske posesti v Ameriki in Zahodno Indijo; evropska ozemlja, kot so Nizke dežele, italijanska ozemlja, Portugalska in deli Francije; ter Filipine in druge posesti v jugovzhodni Aziji. To obdobje španske zgodovine imenujejo tudi »doba širitve«.

Člani rodbine imena Habsburg niso vedno uporabljali, pogosto so poudarjali svoje uglednejše kneževske naslove. Dinastija je bila dolgo znana kot »avstrijska hiša«. Poimenovanje tega obdobja kot »habsburškega« je do neke mere pripomoček zgodovinarjev.

source.title: Habsburg Spain
paragraphs: Habsburg Spain, also known as the Catholic Monarchy, was the period of Spanish history and Spanish Empire from 1516 to 1700 when it was ruled by kings from the House of Habsburg. In this period the Spanish Empire was at the zenith of its power and influence. During this period, Spain held many territories, including Pan-American continental holdings and the West Indies; European territories like the Low Countries, Italian territories, Portugal and parts of France; and the Philippines and other possessions in Southeast Asia. The period of Spanish history has also been referred to as the "Age of Expansion".

The Habsburg name was not always used by the family members, who often emphasized their more prestigious princely titles. The dynasty was long known as the "House of Austria". Calling this era "Habsburg", is, to some extent, a convenience for historians.

Hwicce.headline: Hwicce
paragraphs: Hwicce je bilo kraljestvo v anglosaški Angliji. Po Anglosaški kroniki je bilo ustanovljeno leta 577, po bitki pri Deorhamu. Po letu 628 je zaradi bitke pri Cirencestru postalo odvisno kraljestvo ali podkraljestvo Mercie.
V popisu Tribal Hidage je bilo Hwicce ocenjeno na 7000 hid, kar ustreza kmetijskemu gospodarstvu kraljestva Essex ali Sussex.

Natančne meje kraljestva niso znane, verjetno pa so se ujemale z mejami stare škofije Worcester, ustanovljene v letih 679–680, katere zgodnji škofje so nosili naslov Episcopus Hwicciorum. Kraljestvo bi torej obsegalo Worcestershire brez severozahodnega roba, Gloucestershire brez gozda Dean, jugozahodno polovico Warwickshira, okolico Batha severno od reke Avon, del zahodnega Oxfordshira ter majhne dele Herefordshira, Shropshira, Staffordshira in severozahodnega Wiltshira.
notes: The Old English pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Hwicce
paragraphs: Hwicce (Old English: [ˈʍittʃe]) was a kingdom in Anglo-Saxon England. According to the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, the kingdom was established in 577, after the Battle of Deorham. After 628, the kingdom became a client or sub-kingdom of Mercia as a result of the Battle of Cirencester.
The Tribal Hidage assessed Hwicce at 7,000 hides, an agricultural economy akin to either the kingdom of Essex or Sussex.

The exact boundaries of the kingdom remain uncertain, though it is likely that they coincided with those of the old Diocese of Worcester, founded in 679–680, the early bishops of which bore the title Episcopus Hwicciorum. The kingdom would therefore have included Worcestershire except the northwestern tip, Gloucestershire except the Forest of Dean, the southwestern half of Warwickshire, the neighbourhood of Bath north of the Avon, part of west Oxfordshire and small parts of Herefordshire, Shropshire, Staffordshire and north-west Wiltshire.

Irska svobodna država (6. decembra 1922 – 29. decembra 1937), znana tudi z irskim imenom Saorstát Éireann, je bila irska država, ustanovljena decembra 1922 na podlagi angleško-irske pogodbe iz decembra 1921, sprva kot dominion. Pogodba je končala triletno irsko osamosvojitveno vojno med silami Irske republike, Irsko republikansko armado (IRA), in silami britanske krone.

source.title: Irish Free State
paragraphs: The Irish Free State (6 December 1922 – 29 December 1937), also known by its Irish name Saorstát Éireann, was the Irish state established in December 1922 under the Anglo-Irish Treaty of December 1921, initially as a Dominion. The treaty ended the three-year Irish War of Independence between the forces of the Irish Republic—the Irish Republican Army (IRA)—and British Crown forces.

Kingdom of Alba.headline: Kraljestvo Alba
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Alba (latinsko: Scotia; škotsko gelsko: Alba) je bilo ime Kraljevine Škotske v obdobju od smrti Donalda II. leta 900 do smrti Aleksandra III. leta 1286. Aleksandrova smrt je posredno pripeljala do vdora angleškega kralja Edvarda I. na Škotsko leta 1296 in do prve škotske osamosvojitvene vojne.

Alba je vključevala Dalriado, sprva pa ni obsegala velikih delov današnjega Škotskega nižavja, ki sta si ga tedaj vse do zaliva Firth of Forth na severu delila Strathclyde in Northumbrija. Piktsko kraljestvo Fortriu na severu je bilo Albi priključeno v 10. stoletju.
Do začetka 13. stoletja Moraya niso šteli za del Albe, za katero so menili, da sega le od zaliva Firth of Forth do reke Spey.

source.title: Kingdom of Alba
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Alba (Latin: Scotia; Scottish Gaelic: Alba) was the Kingdom of Scotland between the deaths of Donald II in 900 and of Alexander III in 1286. The latter's death led indirectly to an invasion of Scotland by Edward I of England in 1296 and the First War of Scottish Independence.

Alba included Dalriada, but initially excluded large parts of the present-day Scottish Lowlands, which were then divided between Strathclyde and Northumbria as far north as the Firth of Forth. Fortriu, a Pictish kingdom in the north, was added to Alba in the tenth century.
Until the early 13th century, Moray was not considered part of Alba, which was seen as extending only between the Firth of Forth and the River Spey.

Kraljestvo Kastilija je bilo srednjeveška država na Iberskem polotoku. Izvira iz grofije Kastilija iz 9. stoletja, vzhodnega obmejnega gospostva Kraljestva León. Kastiljski grofje so v 10. stoletju povečali svojo samostojnost, a šele leta 1065 se je Kastilija ločila od Kraljestva León in postala samostojno kraljestvo. Med letoma 1072 in 1157 je bila znova združena z Leónom, po letu 1230 pa je zveza postala trajna.

V tem obdobju so kastiljski kralji na jugu Iberskega polotoka na račun islamskih kneževin veliko osvojili. Kraljestvi Kastilija in León s svojimi južnimi pridobitvami sta postali znani kot Kastiljska krona, izraz, ki je pozneje zajemal tudi čezmorsko širitev.

source.title: Kingdom of Castile
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Castile was a polity in the Iberian Peninsula during the Middle Ages. It traces its origins to the 9th-century County of Castile, as an eastern frontier lordship of the Kingdom of León. During the 10th century, the Castilian counts increased their autonomy, but it was not until 1065 that it was separated from the Kingdom of León and became a kingdom in its own right. Between 1072 and 1157, it was again united with León, and after 1230, the union became permanent.

Throughout that period, the Castilian kings made extensive conquests in southern Iberia at the expense of the Islamic principalities. The Kingdoms of Castile and of León, with their southern acquisitions, came to be known collectively as the Crown of Castile, a term that also came to encompass overseas expansion.

Kraljestvo Vzhodnih Anglov (staroangleško: Ēastengla Rīċe; latinsko: Regnum Orientalium Anglorum), neuradno znano kot Kraljestvo Vzhodna Anglija ali Vzhodna Anglija, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo Anglov v anglosaškem obdobju, ki je obstajalo od 6. stoletja do leta 918 n. št. Obsegalo je ozemlje današnjih angleških grofij Norfolk in Suffolk ter morda vzhodni del Fens; območje se še danes imenuje Vzhodna Anglija.

Kraljestvo, ki je nastalo v 6. stoletju po anglosaški naselitvi Britanije, je bilo eno od kraljestev heptarhije. V 7. in 8. stoletju je vladala rodbina Wuffingas, leta 794 pa je ozemlje zavzel mercijski kralj Offa. Po Offovi smrti je mercijska oblast za kratek čas popustila, nato pa so jo znova vzpostavili. Danska velika poganska vojska se je leta 865 izkrcala v Vzhodni Angliji; po zavzetju Yorka se je vrnila, leta 869 ubila kralja Edmunda (»Mučenca«) in deželo spremenila v dansko. Ko je Alfred Veliki Dancem vsilil pogodbo, je Vzhodna Anglija ostala del danskega prava (Danelaw).
notes: The English pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of East Anglia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the East Angles (/ˈæŋ.ɡli.ə/; Old English: Ēastengla Rīċe; Latin: Regnum Orientalium Anglorum), informally known as the Kingdom of East Anglia or East Anglia, was an early medieval English kingdom of the Angles during the Anglo-Saxon period, existing from the 6th century to 918 CE. It comprised the territory which now constitutes the English counties of Norfolk and Suffolk and perhaps the eastern part of the Fens; the area is still known as East Anglia.

The kingdom formed in the 6th century in the wake of the Anglo-Saxon settlement of Britain was one of the kingdoms of the Heptarchy. It was ruled by the Wuffingas dynasty in the 7th and 8th centuries, but the territory was taken by Offa of Mercia in 794. Mercian control lapsed briefly following the death of Offa but was re-established. The Danish Great Heathen Army landed in East Anglia in 865; after taking York it returned to East Anglia, killing King Edmund ("the Martyr") and making it Danish land in 869. After Alfred the Great forced a treaty with the Danes, East Anglia was left as part of the Danelaw.

Kraljestvo Vzhodnih Sasov, imenovano Kraljestvo Essex, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo, eno od sedmih tradicionalnih kraljestev anglosaškega obdobja. Ustanovljeno je bilo v 6. stoletju in je obsegalo ozemlje poznejših grofij Essex in Middlesex, velikega dela Hertfordshira in (za kratek čas) zahodnega Kenta. Zadnji kralj Essexa je bil Sigered, ki je leta 825 kraljestvo prepustil wessexškemu kralju Ecgberhtu.

source.title: Kingdom of Essex
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the East Saxons, referred to as the Kingdom of Essex, was an early medieval English kingdom, constituting one of the seven traditional kingdoms of the Anglo-Saxon period. It was founded in the 6th century and covered the territory later occupied by the counties of Essex, Middlesex, much of Hertfordshire and (for a short while) west Kent. The last king of Essex was Sigered of Essex, who in 825 ceded the kingdom to Ecgberht, King of Wessex.

Kraljestvo Galicija je bilo politična tvorba v jugozahodni Evropi, ki je na vrhuncu ozemeljskega obsega zavzemala ves severozahod Iberskega polotoka. Nastalo je v začetku 10. stoletja z razdelitvijo Kraljestva Asturija po smrti Alfonza III. leta 910: njegovi sinovi so si kraljestvo razdelili in Galicijo je podedoval Ordoño II. Galicija je postala samostojna politična tvorba, a je z leonskim in asturijskim kraljestvom ostala tesno povezana z dinastičnimi vezmi. Ordoño II. jo je pozneje, ko je podedoval León, vključil v Kraljestvo León. Kraljestvo Galicija je bilo občasno napol neodvisno, navadno pa so ga imeli za del Kraljestva León. Santiago de Compostela je postal prestolnica Galicije v 11. stoletju, neodvisnost Portugalske (1128) pa je določila njeno južno mejo. Ko je kastiljski kralj Ferdinand III. leta 1230 nasledil leonski prestol, je Galicija prišla pod nadzor Kastiljske krone.

source.title: Kingdom of Galicia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Galicia was a political entity located in southwestern Europe, which, at its territorial zenith, occupied the entire northwest of the Iberian Peninsula. In the early 10th century, the Kingdom of Galicia was formed following the division of the Kingdom of Asturias after the death of Alfonso III in 910. His sons split the kingdom, with Ordoño II inheriting Galicia. While Galicia became a distinct political entity, it remained closely tied to the Leonese and Asturian realms through dynastic connections. Later, Ordoño II integrated Galicia into the Kingdom of León when he inherited the latter. Though the Kingdom of Galicia had moments of semi-independence, it was typically seen as part of the Kingdom of León. Santiago de Compostela became the capital of Galicia in the 11th century, while the independence of Portugal (1128) determined its southern boundary. The accession of Castilian King Ferdinand III to the Leonese kingdom in 1230 brought Galicia under the control of the Crown of Castile.

Gwent (starovaližansko: Guent) je bil srednjeveško valižansko kraljestvo med rekama Wye in Usk. Obstajal je od konca rimske oblasti v Britaniji okoli 5. stoletja do normanske invazije na Wales v 11. stoletju.
